blocks/components/AlertDialog/AlertDialo.name: AlertDialog — Loading
blocks/components/AlertDialog/AlertDialo.description: A confirmation dialog that shows a spinner while the action runs.

blocks/components/AlertDialog/AlertDialo.name: AlertDialog — Delete
blocks/components/AlertDialog/AlertDialo.description: A delete button that asks the user to confirm before deleting.

blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellConte.name: AppShell — Content Only
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellConte.description: Minimal shell with no navigation, useful for full-bleed pages, auth screens, or embedded views.

blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellMobil.name: useAppShellMobile — Custom Mobile Trigger
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellMobil.description: Custom mobile navigation trigger built with useAppShellMobile. The trigger consumes the surrounding AppShell context instead of rendering its own shell.

blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellShowc.name: AppShell
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellShowc.description: A basic app shell with content padding.

blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellSideN.name: AppShell — Side Nav Only
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellSideN.description: App shell with SideNav header providing app identity, no TopNav needed.

blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellTopNa.name: AppShell — Top Nav Only
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellTopNa.description: Simple layout with TopNav and no side navigation, suitable for landing pages.

blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellTopNa.name: AppShell — Top Nav with Side Nav
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellTopNa.displayName: AppShell — Top Nav with Side Nav
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellTopNa.description: The most common layout with TopNav for app identity and SideNav for page-level navigation.

blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellWithB.name: AppShell — With Banner
blocks/components/AppShell/AppShellWithB.description: Full layout with TopNav, SideNav, and a dismissable info banner between the nav and content.

blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.name: AspectRatio — Circle Image
blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.description: Circular container via shape="ellipse" with ratio={1}, ideal for avatars and profile images.

blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.name: AspectRatio — Image Gallery
blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.description: Grid of images with consistent 4:3 aspect ratios.

blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.name: AspectRatio
blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.description: Three aspect ratio containers at equal height (1:1, 4:3, and 16:9), each showing an image with its ratio labeled below.

blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.name: AspectRatio — Square Image
blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.description: 1:1 square aspect ratio, ideal for avatars and Instagram-style images.

blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.name: AspectRatio — 16:9 Widescreen Image
blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.description: 16:9 widescreen aspect ratio wrapping an image.

blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.name: AspectRatio — Loading Skeleton
blocks/components/AspectRatio/AspectRati.description: Aspect ratio container with a skeleton loading placeholder.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarFallbackC.name: Avatar — Fallback Chain
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarFallbackC.description: Demonstrates the avatar fallback chain: primary image, fallback image, initials, then default icon.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarGroup.doc.name: Avatar — Group
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarGroup.doc.description: Overlap multiple avatars in a row to represent a group of people. Use for team lists, PR reviewers, or participant counts where you want to show faces without taking up much space.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarInitialsF.name: Avatar — Initials
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarInitialsF.description: Show initials instead of a photo. The avatar extracts the first and last initials from the name automatically. Use when you only have a user name, like in anonymous accounts or new user onboarding.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarInteracti.name: Avatar — Interactive
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarInteracti.description: Make an avatar interactive by passing `href` to render it as a link or `onClick` to render it as a button. Both forms are focusable and show a focus-visible ring for keyboard users. Use for profile links, mention pop-ups, or any avatar people can act on.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarShowcase..name: Avatar
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarShowcase..description: Avatars at every size with an image, initials fallback, and a status dot. A quick visual reference for choosing the right size.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarTooltip.d.name: Avatar — Tooltip
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarTooltip.d.description: By default an avatar shows its name in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. Pass a string to show custom text instead, or false to turn the tooltip off.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarUserCard..name: Avatar — User Card
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarUserCard..description: Place an avatar next to a name and role to create a user card row. Use for comment headers, contact lists, profile sections, or anywhere you need to identify a person at a glance.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarWithImage.name: Avatar — Photo
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarWithImage.description: Show a profile photo at different sizes. Use when you have a user photo URL. If the image fails to load, initials are shown instead.

blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarWithStatu.name: Avatar — Status Dot
blocks/components/Avatar/AvatarWithStatu.description: Add a status dot to an avatar to show whether someone is online, away, or busy. Use in chat, messaging, or any UI where knowing availability matters.

blocks/components/AvatarGroup/AvatarGrou.name: AvatarGroup — Interactive
blocks/components/AvatarGroup/AvatarGrou.description: A facepile whose avatars link to profiles, with an overflow indicator that opens the full member list. The whole group is one Tab stop; arrow keys move between the avatars and the overflow button.

blocks/components/AvatarGroup/AvatarGrou.name: AvatarGroup
blocks/components/AvatarGroup/AvatarGrou.description: Overlapping avatar rows with a sliced visible set and a server-side overflow count. Shows team members in a compact facepile layout.

blocks/components/AvatarGroupOverflow/Av.name: AvatarGroupOverflow — Custom Text
blocks/components/AvatarGroupOverflow/Av.description: Provide short custom children such as 12+ when the overflow count needs compact product-specific formatting.

blocks/components/AvatarGroupOverflow/Av.name: AvatarGroupOverflow — Default Count
blocks/components/AvatarGroupOverflow/Av.description: Use AvatarGroupOverflow without children to render the standard +N overflow count.

blocks/components/AvatarGroupOverflow/Av.name: AvatarGroupOverflow
blocks/components/AvatarGroupOverflow/Av.description: Overflow indicators for hidden avatars, including the default +N label and custom count text.

blocks/components/AvatarStatusDot/Avatar.name: AvatarStatusDot
blocks/components/AvatarStatusDot/Avatar.description: AvatarStatusDot renders a presence indicator on an Avatar, with variants for positive, neutral, and negative states. The dot size automatically coordinates with the Avatar size.

blocks/components/AvatarStatusDot/Avatar.name: AvatarStatusDot — Variants
blocks/components/AvatarStatusDot/Avatar.description: Presence dots on Avatars using the success, neutral, and error variants. Pass an AvatarStatusDot to the Avatar status prop; the dot sizes itself to match the Avatar.

blocks/components/Badge/BadgeCategoryTag.name: Badge — Colors
blocks/components/Badge/BadgeCategoryTag.description: Tag items with color-coded categories like teams, priorities, or topics. Use the 9 non-semantic color variants when you need to distinguish groups visually.

blocks/components/Badge/BadgeCountBadges.name: Badge — Counts
blocks/components/Badge/BadgeCountBadges.description: Show a number inside a badge for notification counts, unread messages, or task totals. Use next to icons, nav items, or list labels.

blocks/components/Badge/BadgeShowcase.do.name: Badge — Variants
blocks/components/Badge/BadgeShowcase.do.description: All semantic and color badge variants in a single view. Use semantic variants for status and color variants for categories.

blocks/components/Badge/BadgeStatusLabel.name: Badge — Status
blocks/components/Badge/BadgeStatusLabel.description: Show the state of an item like Active, Pending, or Failed. Use in table rows, list items, or detail pages where users need to see status at a glance.

blocks/components/Banner/BannerCollapsib.name: Banner — Collapsible
blocks/components/Banner/BannerCollapsib.description: Combine an action button, dismiss control, and a collapsible detail area in one banner. Children sit behind the toggle by default; `collapsible={{defaultIsOpen: true}}` starts it open, and `collapsible={false}` drops the toggle entirely. Use for complex notifications like config changes or deployment summaries.

blocks/components/Banner/BannerDismissab.name: Banner — Dismiss
blocks/components/Banner/BannerDismissab.description: Let the user close a banner after reading it. Use for maintenance notices, feature tips, or any non-critical message the user can acknowledge.

blocks/components/Banner/BannerFloating..name: Banner — Floating
blocks/components/Banner/BannerFloating..description: A floating banner raised with `elevation="med"`. Banners are inline by default; raise one when it should read as an overlay above content.

blocks/components/Banner/BannerSectionVa.name: Banner — Full Width
blocks/components/Banner/BannerSectionVa.description: A full-width banner with no border radius for page-level notifications. Use at the top of a page for site-wide announcements or maintenance alerts.

blocks/components/Banner/BannerShowcase..name: Banner — Statuses
blocks/components/Banner/BannerShowcase..description: All four status banners stacked: info, success, warning, and error. A quick visual reference for choosing the right status.

blocks/components/Banner/BannerStatuses..name: Banner — Statuses
blocks/components/Banner/BannerStatuses..description: All 4 banner statuses: info, success, warning, and error. Use to show persistent messages like updates, confirmations, cautions, or problems at the top of a page or section.

blocks/components/Banner/BannerWithActio.name: Banner — Action
blocks/components/Banner/BannerWithActio.description: Add a button to a banner so the user can act on the message. Use for trial expirations, payment failures, or anything that needs a response.

blocks/components/BaseTypeahead/BaseType.name: BaseTypeahead — Custom Search Bar
blocks/components/BaseTypeahead/BaseType.description: BaseTypeahead embedded inside a custom-styled wrapper. The wrapper provides its own border and icon chrome; anchorRef positions the dropdown relative to it. Use this pattern when Typeahead's built-in field layout does not fit your composition.

blocks/components/BaseTypeahead/BaseType.name: BaseTypeahead
blocks/components/BaseTypeahead/BaseType.description: A custom result renderer that adds supporting metadata while BaseTypeahead retains option semantics and keyboard behavior.

blocks/components/Blockquote/BlockquoteS.name: Blockquote — Showcase
blocks/components/Blockquote/BlockquoteS.description: Blockquote with and without citation. A quick visual reference for the blockquote component.

blocks/components/Blockquote/BlockquoteT.name: Blockquote — Testimonials
blocks/components/Blockquote/BlockquoteT.description: Multiple quotes arranged in a card grid for a testimonials section. Combine with Card and Grid to create social-proof layouts.

blocks/components/Blockquote/BlockquoteW.name: Blockquote — With Attribution
blocks/components/Blockquote/BlockquoteW.description: A plain quote and a quote with a cite attribution. Use cite to credit the original author or source.

blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.name: Bottom Sheet — Height variants
blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.description: Compares hug, capped, and tall starting heights for different amounts of content.

blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.name: Bottom Sheet — Mobile keyboard
blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.description: Uses a tall, scrollable form that keeps focused controls visible above the mobile keyboard.

blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.name: Bottom Sheet — No scrim
blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.description: Keeps the page visible and interactive behind a non-modal bottom sheet.

blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.name: Bottom Sheet
blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.description: A mobile filter surface that rises from the bottom edge.

blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.name: Bottom Sheet — Snap points
blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.description: Drag-to-resize stops: a half-height working surface, and a peek that slides away and thins the scrim.

blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.name: Bottom Sheet — Review flow
blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.description: A two-step form flow of two standalone sheets driven by one state value: Continue replaces the review step with the confirmation in place, and Back returns.

blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.name: Bottom Sheet — Multi-step flow
blocks/components/BottomSheet/BottomShee.description: A three-step flow of standalone sheets of different heights, driven by one state value: moving on replaces the open step in place. This is the replacement for the deprecated BottomSheetSwitcher.

blocks/components/BreadcrumbItem/Breadcr.name: BreadcrumbItem — Basic
blocks/components/BreadcrumbItem/Breadcr.description: Breadcrumb links inside a Breadcrumbs trail. Ancestor pages get an href; mark the last item with isCurrent to render it as plain text for the current page.

blocks/components/BreadcrumbItem/Breadcr.name: BreadcrumbItem
blocks/components/BreadcrumbItem/Breadcr.description: BreadcrumbItem represents a single step in a breadcrumb trail, supporting links, icons, current-page markers, and custom link components.

blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumbs — Separators
blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.description: Swap the default "/" for a different character like chevrons, arrows, or dots. Use when the visual style of the page calls for a different separator.

blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumbs — Deep Path
blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.description: A 5-level breadcrumb trail for deeply nested content. Use in e-commerce, file browsers, or any UI with several levels of hierarchy.

blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumbs — Menu item
blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.description: Give a mid-trail crumb a `menu` prop to turn it into a menu trigger for switching between sibling destinations. It reuses the same item API as DropdownMenu, so an existing option array (or composed item children) drops in verbatim.

blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumbs
blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.description: A breadcrumb trail showing page hierarchy with linked ancestors and a current page.

blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumbs — Variants
blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.description: Compare the default and supporting variants side by side. Use the supporting variant in dense UIs like admin panels where the breadcrumb should be subtle.

blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.name: Breadcrumbs — Icons
blocks/components/Breadcrumbs/Breadcrumb.description: Add icons before breadcrumb labels for quick recognition. Use a home icon on the root item and contextual icons on key sections.

blocks/components/Button/ButtonFloating..name: Button — Floating
blocks/components/Button/ButtonFloating..description: A floating action button raised with `elevation="med"`. Use elevation for buttons that hover above content, like a FAB.

blocks/components/Button/ButtonShowcase..name: Button — Variants
blocks/components/Button/ButtonShowcase..description: All four button variants side by side: primary, secondary, ghost, and destructive. A quick visual reference for choosing the right variant.

blocks/components/Button/ButtonSizeVaria.name: Button — Sizes
blocks/components/Button/ButtonSizeVaria.description: Small, medium, and large buttons side by side. Use small in dense UIs like toolbars, medium for most cases, and large for prominent CTAs.

blocks/components/Button/ButtonVariants..name: Button — Variants
blocks/components/Button/ButtonVariants..description: All 4 button variants in default, disabled, and loading states. Use primary for the main action, secondary for most others, ghost for low-emphasis, and destructive for dangerous actions.

blocks/components/Button/ButtonWithEndSl.name: Button — End Slot
blocks/components/Button/ButtonWithEndSl.description: Buttons with a trailing badge showing a count or status. Use for notification counts, unread messages, or any button that needs a visual indicator.

blocks/components/Button/ButtonWithIcon..name: Button — Icon
blocks/components/Button/ButtonWithIcon..description: Buttons with a leading icon that reinforces the label. Use when the icon helps the user identify the action faster, like a plus for "New" or a trash can for "Delete".

blocks/components/ButtonGroup/ButtonGrou.name: ButtonGroup — Basic
blocks/components/ButtonGroup/ButtonGrou.description: Three related actions joined into a single connected control. Provide a group label for accessibility and keep all buttons the same variant so they read as one unit.

blocks/components/ButtonGroup/ButtonGrou.name: ButtonGroup — Floating
blocks/components/ButtonGroup/ButtonGrou.description: A grouped action bar raised with `elevation="med"`. The connected buttons share one surface, so the shadow lifts them as a unit.

blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarConst.name: Calendar — Constraints
blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarConst.description: Limit which dates can be selected using min/max bounds and custom rules like weekdays only. Use for scheduling UIs where certain dates are unavailable.

blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarRange.name: Calendar — Range
blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarRange.description: Pick a start and end date with the range highlighted between them. Use for booking dates, time-off requests, or report filters.

blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarShowc.name: Calendar
blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarShowc.description: An interactive single-date calendar with a selected date. Click any day to change the selection.

blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarSingl.name: Calendar — Single
blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarSingl.description: Pick one date from a month grid. Use for appointment dates, due dates, or any field that needs a single date.

blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarTwoMo.name: Calendar — Two Months
blocks/components/Calendar/CalendarTwoMo.description: Two months side by side for selecting ranges that span a month boundary. Use in booking or travel UIs where check-in and check-out often fall in different months.

blocks/components/Calendar/useCalendarCo.name: useCalendarConstraints — Hotel Booking Range
blocks/components/Calendar/useCalendarCo.description: A hotel booking range picker enforcing season min/max dates, a 7-night maximum stay once check-in is picked, and a custom rule disabling closed Mondays.

blocks/components/Calendar/useCalendarDa.name: useCalendarDays — Month Grid
blocks/components/Calendar/useCalendarDa.description: A compact custom month view: a seven-column table built from the weeks and dayNames that useCalendarDays returns, with only as many rows as the month needs. Days from the previous and next months are dimmed, and a Week starts on control (Sunday or Monday) reorders both the header and the grid.

blocks/components/Calendar/useCalendarNa.name: useCalendarNavigation — Month Pager
blocks/components/Calendar/useCalendarNa.description: A calendar month pager with previous/next navigation buttons, localized month-year label, and cross-month arrow key navigation using pendingFocus.

blocks/components/Card/CardCallout.doc.m.name: Card — Callout
blocks/components/Card/CardCallout.doc.m.description: Muted-variant cards for tips, notes, or supplementary information. Use when content should be visually distinct but not prominent. The muted variant uses a wash background instead of the elevated default, making it feel recessed rather than raised. Works well in sidebars, help panels, or inline callouts.

blocks/components/Card/CardElevations.do.name: Card — Elevations
blocks/components/Card/CardElevations.do.description: The four elevation levels side by side. Cards are flat by default; raise a card with `elevation` only when it needs to float above surrounding content.

blocks/components/Card/CardShowcase.doc..name: Card
blocks/components/Card/CardShowcase.doc..description: A card with a heading and body text showing the default container style.

blocks/components/Card/CardVariants.doc..name: Card — Variants
blocks/components/Card/CardVariants.doc..description: Default, muted, and color variants side by side. Use color variants to categorize cards visually, like team colors, project tags, or content types. Each color uses the corresponding background token from the theme, so they adapt to light and dark mode automatically.

blocks/components/Card/CardWithInnerLayo.name: Card — Layout
blocks/components/Card/CardWithInnerLayo.description: A card with a structured header, content area, and footer with action buttons. Use for forms, dialogs, or settings panels that need clear sections. Pair Card with Layout to get automatic dividers between header, content, and footer. The footer aligns actions to the right by default.

blocks/components/Card/CardWithSimpleCon.name: Card — Simple
blocks/components/Card/CardWithSimpleCon.description: A card with a heading and body text. Use for summaries, descriptions, or any grouped content that needs visual separation from the page. The card handles its own border, background, and padding; just pass your content as children. Set a width to constrain it, or leave it to fill the parent.

blocks/components/Card/ClickableCardElev.name: ClickableCard — Elevated
blocks/components/Card/ClickableCardElev.description: A clickable card raised with `elevation="med"` so the shadow signals the whole surface is interactive.

blocks/components/Card/ClickableCardShow.name: ClickableCard
blocks/components/Card/ClickableCardShow.description: A clickable card that navigates on click. Nested interactive elements work independently.

blocks/components/Card/ClickableCardWith.name: ClickableCardWithNestedButton
blocks/components/Card/ClickableCardWith.description: A product card that navigates on click but has an independent "Add to cart" button inside.

blocks/components/Card/SelectableCardEle.name: SelectableCard — Elevated
blocks/components/Card/SelectableCardEle.description: Raised selectable cards with `elevation="low"`. The inset selection ring composes on top of the shadow, so a selected card keeps its elevation.

blocks/components/Card/SelectableCardMul.name: SelectableCardMulti
blocks/components/Card/SelectableCardMul.description: Multi-select tag picker using color variant selectable cards with color-matched selection borders.

blocks/components/Card/SelectableCardSho.name: SelectableCard
blocks/components/Card/SelectableCardSho.description: A plan picker with single-select radio behavior. Cards show an accent border when selected.

blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselCards.name: Carousel — Cards
blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselCards.description: A horizontally scrollable row of cards with snap scrolling enabled. Use for feature grids, product lists, or any set of cards that overflows the available width. The carousel adds fade edges and navigation buttons automatically.

blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselShowc.name: Carousel
blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselShowc.description: A horizontal carousel of cards with scroll-snap and navigation buttons. Scroll or click the arrows to browse.

blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselSnap..name: Carousel — Snap
blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselSnap..description: Scroll-snap carousel with navigation buttons and team member cards. Each card snaps to the start edge on scroll. Use when items should be viewed one at a time rather than as a continuous strip.

blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselSnapP.name: useSnapPaging — Onboarding Pages
blocks/components/Carousel/CarouselSnapP.description: Onboarding cards in a Carousel with hasSnap={useSnapPaging()}: under a finger or a trackpad swipe, each flick moves one view and rests on a card's start edge. A switch picks one view or one card per flick through the hook's pages option.

blocks/components/Center/CenterHorizonta.name: Center — Horizontal Center
blocks/components/Center/CenterHorizonta.description: A formatting control group centered with axis="horizontal" in the default horizontal writing mode. In other writing modes, Center currently follows the flex main axis rather than guaranteeing physical horizontal centering.

blocks/components/Center/CenterInsideACa.name: Center — Vertical & Horizontal Center
blocks/components/Center/CenterInsideACa.description: An empty state with an icon, heading, and description centered both vertically and horizontally inside a card. This is the most common use of Center: placing content in the middle of a fixed-height area like a panel, card, or content region. The height prop defines the centering space.

blocks/components/Center/CenterShowcase..name: Center
blocks/components/Center/CenterShowcase..description: Content centered horizontally and vertically inside a fixed-height container.

blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.name: ChatComposer — Attachments
blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.description: Chat composer with removable file tokens in a collapsible drawer. Use when users can attach files or context to their message.

blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.name: ChatComposer — Flat
blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.description: The composer is raised by default (`elevation="low"`). Set `elevation="none"` to flatten it; it then draws a border with the same rest / hover / focus treatment as a text input.

blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.name: ChatComposer — Footer Actions
blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.description: Chat composer with dropdown menus for a model selector and settings in the footer, and a mic button in the send actions slot.

blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.name: ChatComposer — Full Featured
blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.description: Chat composer with all slots populated: collapsible attachment drawer, header actions, context progress bar, footer dropdown menus, and mic button. Shows the maximum composer configuration.

blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.name: ChatComposer — Simple
blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.description: Minimal chat composer with a placeholder and submit handler. The simplest way to drop a message input into a page.

blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.name: ChatComposer — Streaming
blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.description: Chat composer with streaming state and a stop button. Use when the assistant is generating a response and the user can cancel.

blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.name: ChatComposer — Validation
blocks/components/ChatComposer/ChatCompo.description: Chat composer with error and warning status messages. Status can appear above or below the composer to surface validation or system feedback.

blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.name: ChatComposerDrawer — Attachments
blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.description: Drawer with two rows: a scrollable carousel of image thumbnails and a row of removable file tokens. Omit count to keep the drawer always expanded.

blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.name: ChatComposerDrawer — Collapsible
blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.description: Drawer with many items and a collapse toggle. Pass count to enable the toggle; collapsed state shows a badge with the total count and a label.

blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.name: ChatComposerDrawer — Feedback
blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.description: Chat composer drawer with a feedback prompt and selectable lettered options. Use for user confirmation workflows that require explicit action before proceeding.

blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.name: ChatComposerDrawer
blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.description: Composer drawer with file tokens, a collapsible toggle, and header actions. Use as a starting point for any chat composer with attachments.

blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.name: ChatComposerDrawer — With Progress
blocks/components/ChatComposerDrawer/Cha.description: Drawer paired with a context progress bar in the header. Show context window usage when attachments consume part of the available token budget.

blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.name: ChatComposerInput — Controlled
blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.description: Controlled chat input with live value display. Use controlled mode when you need to read or transform the input value outside the composer.

blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.name: ChatComposerInput — Disabled
blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.description: Composer in a disabled state. Use when the input should be visible but not interactive, such as during streaming or when a prerequisite is unmet.

blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.name: ChatComposerInput — Mentions
blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.description: Chat input with an @ trigger that opens a typeahead menu for mentioning users. Selected names appear as inline tokens.

blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.name: ChatComposerInput — Multiple Triggers
blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.description: Chat input with both @ mentions and / commands. Each trigger type renders tokens in a distinct color so users can tell them apart at a glance.

blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.name: ChatComposerInput — Slash Commands
blocks/components/ChatComposerInput/Chat.description: Chat input with a / trigger for command selection. Use for AI assistants or bots that support structured commands.

blocks/components/ChatDictation/ChatDict.name: ChatDictationButton — In Composer
blocks/components/ChatDictation/ChatDict.description: Dictation button placed in the sendActions slot of a chat composer. Shows the recommended integration point for voice input alongside the send button.

blocks/components/ChatDictation/ChatDict.name: ChatDictationButton — States
blocks/components/ChatDictation/ChatDict.description: Dictation button in idle, listening, and speaking states side by side. Shows the three visual phases of a voice input interaction.

blocks/components/ChatDictation/ChatDict.name: ChatDictationButton — Sizes
blocks/components/ChatDictation/ChatDict.description: Small and medium dictation buttons side by side. Use small in compact composer densities and medium for standard layouts.

blocks/components/ChatDictationButton/Ch.name: ChatDictationButton — Basic
blocks/components/ChatDictationButton/Ch.description: A dictation button wired to useChatDictation and placed in the sendActions slot of a ChatComposer. Click the microphone to transcribe speech into the input.

blocks/components/ChatDictationButton/Ch.name: ChatDictationButton
blocks/components/ChatDictationButton/Ch.description: Interactive dictation button connected to the SpeechRecognition API via useChatDictation. Click the mic to dictate into the composer.

blocks/components/ChatLayout/ChatLayoutP.name: ChatLayout — Panel View
blocks/components/ChatLayout/ChatLayoutP.description: Narrow sidebar chat in a constrained container that triggers compact density. Use for side panels, drawers, or embedded chat widgets where horizontal space is limited.

blocks/components/ChatLayoutScrollButton.name: ChatLayoutScrollButton — Labels
blocks/components/ChatLayoutScrollButton.description: Scroll button with different labels for context-specific notifications like new messages, unread replies, or a generic scroll prompt.

blocks/components/ChatLayoutScrollButton.name: ChatLayoutScrollButton
blocks/components/ChatLayoutScrollButton.description: Scroll button in hidden, visible, and expanded (with label) states. The button fades in when the user scrolls up and expands when new messages arrive.

blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.name: ChatMessage — Avatar & Name
blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.description: Messages with avatars and sender names. Place the name on the bubble when using bubbles, or on the message wrapper for raw content.

blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.name: ChatMessage — Ghost
blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.description: Ghost variant for messages without visible bubble boundaries. Keeps padding for alignment but renders a transparent background, useful for AI-style responses.

blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.name: ChatMessage — Multi-Bubble
blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.description: Grouped bubbles using the group prop for corner radius reduction. Use first, middle, and last to visually connect related bubbles from the same sender.

blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.name: ChatMessage
blocks/components/ChatMessage/ChatMessag.description: A user multi-bubble group with delivery status and an assistant ghost response with avatar, name, timestamp, and model info.

blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.name: ChatMessageBubble — Custom Content
blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.description: Custom in-message content aligned to the bubble text column. An artifact card is wrapped in a ghost bubble with width="100%", so its left edge matches the bubble text and it spans the full message column instead of the default bubble width cap; the timestamp rides the bubble metadata slot.

blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.name: ChatMessageBubble — Density
blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.description: Compact, balanced, and spacious density modes side by side. Density controls bubble padding, corner radius, and spacing between grouped bubbles.

blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.name: ChatMessageBubble — Grouping
blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.description: Multi-bubble messages using first, middle, and last group positions. Grouped bubbles tighten corner radius on the sender side for a continuous visual flow.

blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.name: ChatMessageBubble — Metadata
blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.description: Bubbles with name and metadata slots aligned to bubble padding. Put name on the first bubble and metadata on the last bubble in a message.

blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.name: ChatMessageBubble
blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.description: Grouped user bubbles with filled styling and a ghost-variant agent response, with timestamps and delivery status.

blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.name: ChatMessageBubble — Variants
blocks/components/ChatMessageBubble/Chat.description: Filled and ghost bubble variants for both user and assistant senders. Use filled for standard messages and ghost when content needs alignment without a visual boundary.

blocks/components/ChatMessageList/ChatMe.name: ChatMessageList — Density
blocks/components/ChatMessageList/ChatMe.description: Side-by-side comparison of compact, balanced, and spacious densities. Use compact in sidebars or panels, balanced for most full-page chat, and spacious for long-form reading. Use gap when row spacing needs to differ from density.

blocks/components/ChatMessageList/ChatMe.name: ChatMessageList — Full Featured
blocks/components/ChatMessageList/ChatMe.description: Conversation showcasing system messages, multi-bubble grouping, markdown, code blocks, and metadata. Combines date dividers, ghost bubbles, grouped messages, and rich content in a single example.

blocks/components/ChatMessageList/ChatMe.name: ChatMessageList
blocks/components/ChatMessageList/ChatMe.description: Basic AI chat conversation with user and assistant messages. The simplest way to render a message list with alternating sender bubbles, metadata, and a date divider.

blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.name: ChatMessageMetadata — Footer Actions
blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.description: Assistant message with footer actions: copy, retry, thumbs up/down, and model label. Use for AI responses that need feedback or utility controls.

blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.name: ChatMessageMetadata
blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.description: Three-message conversation showcasing error status with retry, delivery status, and full footer actions with model label.

blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.name: ChatMessageMetadata — Status
blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.description: All 5 delivery statuses (sending, sent, delivered, read, and error), each with a timestamp. Use to show message delivery progress or surface failures.

blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.name: ChatMessageMetadata — Timestamps
blocks/components/ChatMessageMetadata/Ch.description: Timestamp-only metadata on user and assistant messages. Supports absolute time and relative formats via Timestamp.

blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.name: ChatSendButton — Custom Icon
blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.description: Send buttons with custom icons via sendIcon and stopIcon props. Use to match the personality of the chat experience: a paper airplane for messaging, sparkles for AI generation, or a check mark for confirmation flows.

blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.name: ChatSendButton — In Composer
blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.description: Send button inside ChatComposer, where it reads state from context automatically. No wiring needed; the button enables when the input has content.

blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.name: ChatSendButton
blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.description: Ready, custom icon, and streaming states of the send button.

blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.name: ChatSendButton — States
blocks/components/ChatSendButton/ChatSen.description: Disabled, ready, and streaming states at both sizes. The button automatically toggles between send (primary) and stop (secondary) based on streaming state.

blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.name: ChatSystemMessage
blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.description: System messages for date dividers, status updates, and informational notices. Shows both default and divider variants in a realistic conversation flow.

blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.name: ChatSystemMessage — Status Updates
blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.description: Realistic status messages in a conversation flow showing membership changes, timestamps, and resolution notices.

blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.name: ChatSystemMessage — Variants
blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.description: Default and divider variants side by side. Use default for inline status updates and divider for date separators or section breaks.

blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.name: ChatSystemMessage — Icon
blocks/components/ChatSystemMessage/Chat.description: System messages with a leading icon that reinforces the message type. Use icons to help users scan and identify message categories at a glance.

blocks/components/ChatTokenizedText/Chat.name: ChatTokenizedText — Basic
blocks/components/ChatTokenizedText/Chat.description: A message with @mention tokens. Each matching pattern is replaced with its display name badge.

blocks/components/ChatTokenizedText/Chat.name: ChatTokenizedText — Colors
blocks/components/ChatTokenizedText/Chat.description: Tokens with different color variants to distinguish mentions, bugs, and features. Use variant colors to create a visual taxonomy: blue for people, red for bugs, green for features.

blocks/components/ChatToolCalls/ChatTool.name: ChatToolCalls — Expandable
blocks/components/ChatToolCalls/ChatTool.description: Tool calls with expandable result details showing diffs and command output in code blocks. Click a row to reveal its result.

blocks/components/ChatToolCalls/ChatTool.name: ChatToolCalls — Statuses
blocks/components/ChatToolCalls/ChatTool.description: All four status states (pending, running, complete, and error) shown together in a single group.

blocks/components/ChatToolCalls/ChatTool.name: ChatToolCalls — Simple
blocks/components/ChatToolCalls/ChatTool.description: A single inline tool call above a collapsible multi-call group with diff stats. Shows both layouts side by side.

blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.name: CheckboxInput — States
blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.description: Checkboxes with labels and descriptions in checked, unchecked, and disabled states. Each checkbox controls a single on/off setting. Add a description to explain what the setting does.

blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.name: CheckboxInput — Indeterminate
blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.description: A "select all" checkbox that controls a group of options. When only some options are checked, it shows a dash instead of a checkmark. Clicking it checks or unchecks everything.

blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.name: CheckboxInput
blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.description: Interactive checkboxes showing checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states with descriptions.

blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.name: CheckboxInput — Status
blocks/components/CheckboxInput/Checkbox.description: Checkboxes with error, warning, and success validation messages. Use the status prop to show feedback after form validation: errors block submission, warnings inform, and success confirms.

blocks/components/CheckboxList/CheckboxL.name: CheckboxList — Select All With Indeterminate
blocks/components/CheckboxList/CheckboxL.description: A "select all" toggle at the top of a checkbox list that switches to an indeterminate dash when only some items are checked, useful for bulk actions like exporting documents or assigning permissions where users often want everything at once.

blocks/components/CheckboxList/CheckboxL.name: CheckboxList — With End Content
blocks/components/CheckboxList/CheckboxL.description: Badges in the trailing slot show contextual info, like a price or status, next to each option without cluttering the label, so users can compare choices at a glance.

blocks/components/CheckboxListItem/Check.name: CheckboxListItem — Basic
blocks/components/CheckboxListItem/Check.description: Checkbox items with labels and descriptions inside a controlled CheckboxList. Use for multi-select option groups like notification preferences.

blocks/components/CheckboxListItem/Check.name: CheckboxListItem
blocks/components/CheckboxListItem/Check.description: Checkbox list items with labels, descriptions, and different states including disabled.

blocks/components/Citation/CitationInlin.name: Citation — Inline Text
blocks/components/Citation/CitationInlin.description: Citations embedded within a paragraph of text, showing how they flow inline with surrounding content.

blocks/components/Citation/CitationShowc.name: Citation — Showcase
blocks/components/Citation/CitationShowc.description: All citation variants at a glance: label chips and numbered badges, with and without icons and links.

blocks/components/Citation/CitationSourc.name: Citation — Source List
blocks/components/Citation/CitationSourc.description: A list of citation sources with icons, as you might show at the end of an AI-generated response or article footer.

blocks/components/Code/CodeAcrossTextSiz.name: Code — Text Sizes
blocks/components/Code/CodeAcrossTextSiz.description: Inline code rendered inside heading, body, supporting, and label text. Code automatically matches the font size of its parent text element.

blocks/components/Code/CodeInlineInParag.name: Code — Inline
blocks/components/Code/CodeInlineInParag.description: Inline code references mixed within a paragraph of body text. Use Code to mark up function names, hooks, or API terms so they stand out from surrounding prose.

blocks/components/Code/CodeShowcase.doc..name: Code
blocks/components/Code/CodeShowcase.doc..description: Inline code snippets inside a sentence showing how Code renders alongside body text.

blocks/components/Code/CodeVariousConten.name: Code — Content Types
blocks/components/Code/CodeVariousConten.description: Inline code used for variables, terminal commands, CSS properties, file paths, and keyboard shortcuts. Shows how Code adapts to different kinds of technical content.

blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockBas.name: Code — Snippet
blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockBas.description: Short terminal commands with no header: the copy button sits in its own column beside the code, so a one-line command reads as a single row and a long line ends before the button instead of running under it. Use for install instructions or one-liner commands that readers will paste directly.

blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockHig.name: Code — Highlighted
blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockHig.description: TypeScript code with specific lines highlighted to draw attention to a key section. Use highlightLines to call out new or important code in tutorials and changelogs.

blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockJSO.name: Code — Config
blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockJSO.description: A JSON configuration file with a title bar and line numbers. The title prop adds a filename label in the header so readers know which file the code belongs to.

blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockScr.name: Code — Scrollable
blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockScr.description: A long code block with a max height that enables vertical scrolling. Use maxHeight to keep the block from dominating the page when displaying large files.

blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockSho.name: CodeBlock
blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockSho.description: A syntax-highlighted TypeScript code block with line numbers, a title bar, and a copy button.

blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockTer.name: Code — Terminal
blocks/components/CodeBlock/CodeBlockTer.description: A dark terminal-style command block: a bash CodeBlock wrapped in SyntaxTheme with the GitHub Dark preset, copy button on, and no line numbers. Use for shell sessions or CLI output that should read as a terminal even on light pages. Reach for a dark syntax preset instead of hand-rolling a dark box with custom CSS.

blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.name: Collapsible — Controlled
blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.description: Manage the open section from parent state, so something other than a click can move it: a URL parameter, a form jumping to the step that failed validation, or the Previous/Next controls shown here. onChange hands back the whole open value.

blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.name: Collapsible — FAQ
blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.description: FAQ built with hasDividers: row hairlines and density padding with no custom CSS. Questions set their own type — body at semibold, not the trigger's default 17px large — so a list of questions reads as rows rather than a stack of headings, and question and answer separate on weight and color instead of size.

blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.name: useCollapsible — Custom Disclosure
blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.description: Custom disclosure UI built directly with useCollapsible for headless open/close state.

blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.name: Collapsible — Multiple Mode
blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.description: Several sections open at once, for comparing across them — feature lists, pricing tiers. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its own large type: it is the heading of its surface, not a row in a list.

blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.name: Collapsible
blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.description: An accordion group with three collapsible sections in single mode: opening one closes the others.

blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.name: Collapsible — Single Mode
blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.description: Only one section open at a time, so a single body of content competes for attention. Use defaultValue to pre-expand whichever section a first-time reader needs. Each Collapsible owns a Section, so its trigger is that section heading.

blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.name: Collapsible — With Dividers
blocks/components/Collapsible/Collapsibl.description: A flat list on the page background with hand-placed Dividers, for detail panels and sidebars where cards would add too much weight. Rows, so the triggers step down to body-semibold and a supporting metadata line sits under each answer.

blocks/components/CollapsibleGroup/Colla.name: CollapsibleGroup — Density
blocks/components/CollapsibleGroup/Colla.description: density sets the block padding on every row in the group, so a list of sections can be tuned to the surface it sits on without touching the rows. compact for dense surfaces like sidebars and inspectors, balanced (the default) for page content, spacious for a short list that is the main thing on the page. It follows Table's scale and pairs with hasDividers, which turns it on at balanced.

blocks/components/CollapsibleGroup/Colla.name: CollapsibleGroup
blocks/components/CollapsibleGroup/Colla.description: CollapsibleGroup coordinates its Collapsible children: with type="single", opening one closes the others. No state or handlers in the example — the group owns which value is open and each child only declares its own. One Collapsible per Card, so each trigger keeps its default large type as the heading of its own surface.

blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.name: CommandPalette — Async Search
blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.description: Server-side search with loading spinner and custom empty states.

blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.name: CommandPalette — Grouped
blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.description: Command palette with items grouped via auxiliaryData.group.

blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.name: CommandPalette — Custom Footer
blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.description: Command palette with a custom footer tip message.

blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.name: CommandPalette — Picker Mode
blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.description: Single-value picker with persistent selection and check indicator.

blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.name: CommandPalette — Rich Items
blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.description: Custom item rendering with icons, keyboard shortcuts, and keyword search.

blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.name: CommandPalette
blocks/components/CommandPalette/Command.description: Basic command palette with static items and keyboard navigation.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteEmpty/Co.name: CommandPaletteEmpty — Basic
blocks/components/CommandPaletteEmpty/Co.description: A command palette with no results, showing a custom empty message via emptyBootstrapText. Use to explain why the palette is empty and what the user can do next.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteEmpty/Co.name: CommandPaletteEmpty
blocks/components/CommandPaletteEmpty/Co.description: Command palette empty state shown when no commands are available.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteFooter/C.name: CommandPaletteFooter — Basic
blocks/components/CommandPaletteFooter/C.description: A command palette footer with no children, rendering the built-in keyboard navigation hints. Use CommandPaletteFooter without content to get the default arrow-key, Enter, and Esc hints below the results list.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteFooter/C.name: CommandPaletteFooter
blocks/components/CommandPaletteFooter/C.description: Command palette footer with custom tip content.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteGroup/Co.name: CommandPaletteGroup — Basic
blocks/components/CommandPaletteGroup/Co.description: Command palette items organized under group headings using the composed CommandPaletteGroup form. Use to separate related commands into labeled sections.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteGroup/Co.name: CommandPaletteGroup
blocks/components/CommandPaletteGroup/Co.description: Command palette groups in both data-driven (auxiliaryData.group) and composed (CommandPaletteGroup + CommandPaletteItem) forms.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteInput/Co.name: CommandPaletteInput — With End Content
blocks/components/CommandPaletteInput/Co.description: Custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut badge in the trailing slot via endContent.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteInput/Co.name: CommandPaletteInput
blocks/components/CommandPaletteInput/Co.description: Command palette search input with a custom placeholder and a keyboard shortcut hint in the endContent slot.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteItem/Com.name: CommandPaletteItem — Basic
blocks/components/CommandPaletteItem/Com.description: Selectable command palette items inside a CommandPaletteList, including highlighted and disabled states. Use when composing a palette manually instead of a search source.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteItem/Com.name: CommandPaletteItem
blocks/components/CommandPaletteItem/Com.description: An inline command palette whose items pair each command label with its keyboard shortcut through renderItem.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteList/Com.name: CommandPaletteList — Item States
blocks/components/CommandPaletteList/Com.description: Flat list showing the highlighted, selected, and disabled item states. Use CommandPaletteGroup to add section headings.

blocks/components/CommandPaletteList/Com.name: CommandPaletteList
blocks/components/CommandPaletteList/Com.description: Scrollable command palette list with grouped items, including a highlighted item, composed without a full CommandPalette.

blocks/components/ComplexSelector/Comple.name: ComplexSelector — Deadline Picker
blocks/components/ComplexSelector/Comple.description: A multi-step deadline field: pick a preset like Today or Next week, or switch to a custom date and time before applying. The popup stays open until the user commits, so the content owns the Apply action.

blocks/components/ComplexSelector/Comple.name: ComplexSelector
blocks/components/ComplexSelector/Comple.description: A two-axis picker: choose a fruit and a ripeness level from one control. ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore while the custom grid owns its keyboard semantics.

blocks/components/ComplexSelector/Comple.name: ComplexSelector — Tree Search
blocks/components/ComplexSelector/Comple.description: A destination picker that combines a search field with a TreeList hierarchy. TreeList owns tree keyboard navigation; ComplexSelector owns the trigger, popover, and focus restore. Selecting a folder closes the popup.

blocks/components/ContextMenu/ContextMen.name: ContextMenu — Basic
blocks/components/ContextMenu/ContextMen.description: An adaptive context area: long-press opens a BottomSheet on compact touch screens, while right-click opens a cursor-positioned menu elsewhere.

blocks/components/ContextMenu/ContextMen.name: ContextMenu — Bottom Sheet
blocks/components/ContextMenu/ContextMen.description: A ContextMenu using the explicit BottomSheet presentation. Long-press the target on touch devices or right-click it with a pointer. Keep a visible menu trigger for important mobile actions.

blocks/components/ContextMenu/ContextMen.name: ContextMenu
blocks/components/ContextMenu/ContextMen.description: An adaptive context area that supports long-press on compact touch screens and right-click elsewhere.

blocks/components/ContextMenuItem/Contex.name: ContextMenuItem — Basic
blocks/components/ContextMenuItem/Contex.description: Context menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use ContextMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.

blocks/components/ContextMenuItem/Contex.name: ContextMenuItem
blocks/components/ContextMenuItem/Contex.description: Context menu with custom-rendered items using ContextMenuItem for icons and descriptions.

blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputCle.name: DateInput — Clearable
blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputCle.description: Date input with a clear button that resets the value. Use when the date field is optional and the user may need to undo their selection.

blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputDat.name: DateInput — Min/Max Constraints
blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputDat.description: Date input constrained to a min/max window. Use when only certain dates are valid, like booking availability or a fiscal quarter.

blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputFor.name: DateInput — Formats
blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputFor.description: The format prop reuses Timestamp's format vocabulary to control how the committed value is displayed: date, date_long (default), date_weekday, and system_date, or a function for a fully custom string. Formatting applies only to the committed value, never to text the user is actively typing.

blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputSho.name: DateInput
blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputSho.description: A date input field with a calendar popover. Type a date or click the calendar icon to pick one.

blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputWit.name: DateInput — Description
blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputWit.description: Date input with helper text below the label explaining what the field expects. Use when the purpose of the date is not obvious from the label alone.

blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputWit.name: DateInput — Validation
blocks/components/DateInput/DateInputWit.description: Date input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface validation issues, caution the user, or confirm a valid selection.

blocks/components/DateRangeInput/DateRan.name: DateRangeInput
blocks/components/DateRangeInput/DateRan.description: A date range picker with a button trigger and dual-month calendar popover with preset ranges.

blocks/components/DateRangeInput/DateRan.name: DateRangeInput — With Presets
blocks/components/DateRangeInput/DateRan.description: Date range picker with quick-select presets for common periods. Use for analytics dashboards, report filters, or any context where users frequently select standard time windows.

blocks/components/DateRangeInput/DateRan.name: DateRangeInput — Validation
blocks/components/DateRangeInput/DateRan.description: Date range input in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface booking conflicts, flag high-demand periods, or confirm an available range.

blocks/components/DateTimeInput/DateTime.name: DateTimeInput
blocks/components/DateTimeInput/DateTime.description: A combined date and time picker. Desktop opens a calendar popover with a time input; touch devices open a Date/Time bottom sheet.

blocks/components/DateTimeInput/DateTime.name: DateTimeInput — Validation
blocks/components/DateTimeInput/DateTime.description: DateTimeInput in all three status states: error, warning, and success. Use to surface scheduling conflicts, caution the user about edge cases, or confirm a valid datetime.

blocks/components/Dialog/DialogAdaptiveP.name: Dialog — Adaptive presentation
blocks/components/Dialog/DialogAdaptiveP.description: Opt-in recipe for an AdaptiveDialog wrapper: Dialog remains the default everywhere, while touchPresentation="bottom-sheet" switches only at lg and below when pointer is coarse and hover is unavailable. Includes a deterministic presentation override for tests/unusual environments and notes that BottomSheet purpose controls swipe and scrim dismissal. Usage examples: touchPresentation="dialog" keeps Dialog, "fullscreen" chooses fullscreen Dialog, and "bottom-sheet" chooses BottomSheet only for the touch-oriented range. Keep presentation as the deterministic override. Do not use this by default for AlertDialog or destructive confirmations.

blocks/components/Dialog/DialogConfirmat.name: Dialog — Confirmation
blocks/components/Dialog/DialogConfirmat.description: Asks the user to confirm a destructive action before it happens. Use before deleting projects, removing team members, revoking API keys, or any irreversible operation.

blocks/components/Dialog/DialogFormDialo.name: Dialog — Form
blocks/components/Dialog/DialogFormDialo.description: Collects user input without navigating away from the page. Uses purpose="form" so clicking the backdrop won't close it. Use for editing profiles, creating items, or updating settings inline.

blocks/components/Dialog/DialogFullscree.name: Dialog — Fullscreen
blocks/components/Dialog/DialogFullscree.description: Takes over the entire viewport for content that needs maximum space. Use for documentation viewers, rich text editors, multi-step wizards, or media previews where the standard dialog width is too narrow.

blocks/components/Dialog/DialogScrolling.name: Dialog — Scrollable
blocks/components/Dialog/DialogScrolling.description: Constrains the dialog height and scrolls the body when content overflows. Use for terms and conditions, license agreements, changelogs, or any long-form content the user needs to review before accepting.

blocks/components/Dialog/DialogShowcase..name: Dialog
blocks/components/Dialog/DialogShowcase..description: Modal dialog with a header, body content, and close button.

blocks/components/Dialog/DialogWithSubti.name: Dialog — Required
blocks/components/Dialog/DialogWithSubti.description: Cannot be dismissed by Escape or backdrop click; the user must explicitly choose an action. Uses purpose="required". Use for ownership transfers, legal acknowledgements, or critical decisions where skipping is not an option.

blocks/components/DialogHeader/DialogHea.name: DialogHeader — Basic
blocks/components/DialogHeader/DialogHea.description: A DialogHeader with a title, subtitle, and close button, placed in the header slot of a Dialog Layout. Pass onOpenChange to render the close button.

blocks/components/DialogHeader/DialogHea.name: DialogHeader
blocks/components/DialogHeader/DialogHea.description: DialogHeader provides a structured header for dialogs with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.

blocks/components/Divider/DividerFullBle.name: Divider — Full Bleed
blocks/components/Divider/DividerFullBle.description: Divider that extends past container padding to span the full width. Use inside cards or panels when you want a clean edge-to-edge separation, like between an order summary and total.

blocks/components/Divider/DividerShowcas.name: Divider — Variants
blocks/components/Divider/DividerShowcas.description: Horizontal dividers in subtle and strong variants, plus a labeled divider. A quick visual reference for separator styles.

blocks/components/Divider/DividerVariant.name: Divider — Variants
blocks/components/Divider/DividerVariant.description: Subtle, labeled, and strong dividers in a single card. Use subtle between related sections, labeled for alternatives like "or", and strong for high-contrast boundaries.

blocks/components/Divider/DividerVertica.name: Divider — Vertical
blocks/components/Divider/DividerVertica.description: Vertical dividers separating side-by-side metrics. Use between stat cards, toolbar groups, or any horizontal layout where you need a visual boundary between sections.

blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerForm.doc..name: Edit form with footer actions
blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerForm.doc..description: Compose a Layout with DrawerHeader, the fields in LayoutContent, and Cancel and Save in a pinned LayoutFooter. purpose="form" keeps Escape but ignores scrim clicks, so a stray click outside does not discard edits.

blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerScrim.doc.name: Modal or non-modal (hasScrim)
blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerScrim.doc.description: The default modal drawer dims the page, traps focus, and closes on a scrim click. With hasScrim={false}, the drawer has no scrim or focus trap and leaves the page interactive.

blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerShowcase..name: Basic
blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerShowcase..description: Open a modal drawer from a single trigger. The scrim dims the page; Escape, a scrim click, or the header close button closes it, and focus returns to the trigger.

blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerStart.doc.name: Slide in from the start edge
blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerStart.doc.displayName: Slide in from the start edge
blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerStart.doc.description: Set side="start" to open from the inline start edge: left in LTR and right in RTL. The default end edge follows the inspector convention.

blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerWidths.do.name: Width budget: pixels or any CSS length
blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerWidths.do.displayName: Width budget: pixels or any CSS length
blocks/components/Drawer/DrawerWidths.do.description: Compare a numeric pixel width with rem and percentage lengths. The width budget also caps the drawer on mobile.

blocks/components/DrawerHeader/DrawerHea.name: DrawerHeader
blocks/components/DrawerHeader/DrawerHea.description: DrawerHeader provides a structured header for drawers with slots for title, subtitle, close button, and optional start or end content.

blocks/components/DrawerHeader/DrawerHea.name: With subtitle and end content
blocks/components/DrawerHeader/DrawerHea.description: Add a subtitle under the title and put a status, such as a Badge, in endContent. The close button stays at the end of the row.

blocks/components/DrawerHeader/DrawerHea.name: With close button
blocks/components/DrawerHeader/DrawerHea.description: Pass onOpenChange to render a close button that calls it with false. Drawer renders no close button of its own, so this is the usual visible way to close.

blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.name: DropdownMenu — Actions
blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.description: Action menu with dividers separating safe and destructive operations. Use for row-level actions on items like documents, projects, or records.

blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.name: DropdownMenu — Adaptive presentation
blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.description: Chooses a bottom sheet for compact touch surfaces and an anchored popover otherwise. The media query is product policy, while DropdownMenu owns both presentations.

blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.name: DropdownMenu — Icon Trigger
blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.description: Overflow menu triggered by an icon-only button with no chevron or label text. Use for row-level actions in tables, cards, or lists where a text button would take too much space.

blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.name: DropdownMenu
blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.description: A button that opens a dropdown menu with action items. The menu starts open for preview.

blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.name: DropdownMenu — Disabled
blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.description: Menu with selectively disabled items based on permissions. Use when some actions require higher privileges, like admin-only operations.

blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.name: DropdownMenu — Sections
blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.description: Menu items organized into titled sections for easy scanning. Use when you have 6+ actions that fall into distinct categories, like Create vs Manage.

blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.name: DropdownMenu — Submenu
blocks/components/DropdownMenu/DropdownM.description: Action menu with a nested submenu. Hover or Right arrow opens the flyout; Left arrow / Escape closes it. Use to group related destinations or secondary actions without crowding the top level.

blocks/components/DropdownMenuGroup/Drop.name: DropdownMenuGroup
blocks/components/DropdownMenuGroup/Drop.description: A compound-mode menu whose rows are titled in groups. Each DropdownMenuGroup renders a role="group" named by its heading; arrow keys and typeahead skip the heading.

blocks/components/DropdownMenuGroup/Drop.name: DropdownMenuGroup — Selectable rows
blocks/components/DropdownMenuGroup/Drop.description: Titled groups around a radio group and checkbox rows — the rows the data API cannot express, which is why the heading lives in compound mode.

blocks/components/DropdownMenuItem/Dropd.name: DropdownMenuItem — Basic
blocks/components/DropdownMenuItem/Dropd.description: Dropdown menu items with labels and secondary descriptions. Use DropdownMenuItem to render custom menu entries with consistent styling.

blocks/components/DropdownMenuItem/Dropd.name: DropdownMenuItem
blocks/components/DropdownMenuItem/Dropd.description: Dropdown menu with custom-rendered items using DropdownMenuItem for icons and descriptions.

blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateA.name: EmptyState — Actions
blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateA.description: Full empty state with icon, message, and action buttons. Use when a search returns no results, a filter clears all items, or a list has been emptied. The buttons give the user a way forward: go back, clear filters, or try a different query.

blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateC.name: EmptyState — Compact
blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateC.description: Smaller empty state with reduced spacing for constrained areas. Use inside sidebar panels, card widgets, or notification drawers where a full-size empty state would overwhelm the layout.

blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateC.name: EmptyState — Container
blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateC.description: Empty state wrapped in a Card for first-time setup or onboarding. Use when the user has not created any items yet, like a project list, team roster, or dashboard widget that will fill with data once they take action.

blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateS.name: EmptyState
blocks/components/EmptyState/EmptyStateS.description: A no-results empty state with an icon, descriptive message, and a call-to-action button.

blocks/components/Field/FieldRequired.do.name: Field — Required & Optional
blocks/components/Field/FieldRequired.do.description: Required and optional field indicators side by side. Use isRequired on fields the user must fill in, and isOptional to clarify which fields can be skipped.

blocks/components/Field/FieldShowcase.do.name: Field
blocks/components/Field/FieldShowcase.do.description: A form field wrapping a text input with a label, description, and validation status.

blocks/components/Field/FieldStatusVaria.name: Field — Validation States
blocks/components/Field/FieldStatusVaria.description: All three validation states: error, warning, and success. Use error for invalid input, warning for potential issues like reserved names, and success to confirm valid entries like API keys.

blocks/components/Field/FieldWithDescrip.name: Field — Description
blocks/components/Field/FieldWithDescrip.description: Fields with helper text below the label. Use descriptions to explain format requirements, constraints, or what happens with the data, like "At least 8 characters" or "We will send a confirmation link".

blocks/components/FieldLabel/FieldLabelB.name: FieldLabel — Basic
blocks/components/FieldLabel/FieldLabelB.description: Standalone labels with required and optional indicators and a helper description. Use when labeling a custom control that does not render its own label.

blocks/components/FieldLabel/FieldLabelS.name: FieldLabel
blocks/components/FieldLabel/FieldLabelS.description: Standalone field labels demonstrating required, optional, tooltip, and icon variations.

blocks/components/FieldStatus/FieldStatu.name: FieldStatus — Basic
blocks/components/FieldStatus/FieldStatu.description: Detached error and success messages for validation feedback. Use below checkboxes, switches, or custom controls where an attached status would overlap.

blocks/components/FieldStatus/FieldStatu.name: FieldStatus
blocks/components/FieldStatus/FieldStatu.description: Field status messages in error, warning, and success states with attached and detached variants.

blocks/components/FileInput/FileInputBas.name: FileInput — Basic
blocks/components/FileInput/FileInputBas.description: A controlled single-file upload with accepted types, a size limit, and helper text. Use for standard document upload fields in forms.

blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutH.name: FormLayout — Horizontal
blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutH.description: Two fields side by side for naturally paired inputs like first and last name

blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutH.name: FormLayout — Settings Form
blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutH.description: Settings form with labels placed beside their inputs

blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutM.name: FormLayout — Mixed Controls
blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutM.description: Form with different control types: text input, selector, and checkboxes

blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutN.name: FormLayout — Nested Address Form
blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutN.description: Address form mixing vertical and horizontal layouts for grouped fields

blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutS.name: FormLayout
blocks/components/FormLayout/FormLayoutS.description: A vertical form layout with text input fields.

blocks/components/Grid/GridDashboardLayo.name: Grid — Dashboard Layout
blocks/components/Grid/GridDashboardLayo.description: Dashboard layout with mixed-size widgets and a full-width summary row

blocks/components/Grid/GridGalleryExampl.name: Grid — Card Gallery
blocks/components/Grid/GridGalleryExampl.description: Card gallery with responsive columns that maintain consistent widths

blocks/components/Grid/GridResponsiveAut.name: Grid — Responsive Auto-Fit
blocks/components/Grid/GridResponsiveAut.description: Responsive grid where cards stretch to fill remaining space

blocks/components/Grid/GridWithGridSpan..name: Grid — Column Spanning
blocks/components/Grid/GridWithGridSpan..description: Grid with featured items spanning multiple columns and rows

blocks/components/GridSpan/GridSpanColum.name: GridSpan — Columns
blocks/components/GridSpan/GridSpanColum.description: Grid items spanning two of three columns. Wrap a grid child in GridSpan to make it occupy multiple columns for asymmetric layouts.

blocks/components/GridSpan/GridSpanShowc.name: GridSpan
blocks/components/GridSpan/GridSpanShowc.description: GridSpan lets a grid item span multiple columns or rows within an Grid, enabling masonry-style and asymmetric layouts.

blocks/components/HStack/HStackBasic.doc.name: HStack — Basic
blocks/components/HStack/HStackBasic.doc.description: Items arranged in a horizontal row with a consistent gap and centered vertical alignment. Use HStack whenever siblings should sit side by side.

blocks/components/HStack/HStackShowcase..name: HStack
blocks/components/HStack/HStackShowcase..description: Demonstrates HStack arranging items horizontally with different gaps and alignments.

blocks/components/Heading/HeadingCardGri.name: Heading — Card Grid
blocks/components/Heading/HeadingCardGri.description: Responsive card grid with truncated headings and descriptions for uniform layout

blocks/components/Heading/HeadingPageLay.name: Heading — Page Hierarchy
blocks/components/Heading/HeadingPageLay.description: Real-world page layout demonstrating heading levels h1 through h3 with supporting text

blocks/components/Heading/HeadingTruncat.name: Heading — Truncation
blocks/components/Heading/HeadingTruncat.description: Single-line and multi-line heading truncation with ellipsis for constrained layouts

blocks/components/Hooks/useAnnounceHookU.name: useAnnounce — Filter Result Count
blocks/components/Hooks/useAnnounceHookU.description: A product filter that announces its result count with useAnnounce: once typing pauses for 500 ms, a screen reader hears "3 results" or "No results". The count has its own hasReplace instance, as the hook's docs advise for a changing value.

blocks/components/Hooks/useClickableCont.name: useClickableContainer — Clickable Project Card
blocks/components/Hooks/useClickableCont.description: A project card that useClickableContainer makes clickable anywhere: a click on the card follows its title link, while the Star button, the owner link and a text selection keep their own behavior, and Ctrl/Cmd+click or middle-click opens the project in a new tab.

blocks/components/Hooks/useClipboardHook.name: useClipboard — Share Link
blocks/components/Hooks/useClipboardHook.description: A share card that copies its invite link with useClipboard: the Copy button reads "Copied" while isCopied is true, a screen reader hears "Link copied", and a second press restarts the reset timer.

blocks/components/Hooks/useCollatorHookU.name: useCollator — Locale-aware Name Sort
blocks/components/Hooks/useCollatorHookU.description: A list of names sorted with the compare function from useCollator: accented and lowercase names land where a reader expects, and switching the provider locale to Swedish moves Å and Ö after Z.

blocks/components/Hooks/useContainerReve.name: useContainerReveal — Reveal-on-hover Row Actions
blocks/components/Hooks/useContainerReve.description: File rows keep their edit/delete actions hidden at rest and reveal them on hover or keyboard focus via useContainerReveal; the actions stay mounted and in the tab order.

blocks/components/Hooks/useFocusTrapHook.name: useFocusTrap — Quick Edit Panel
blocks/components/Hooks/useFocusTrapHook.description: A custom quick-edit panel, not built on Dialog, that traps focus with useFocusTrap: focusFirst moves focus to its field on open, Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside it, Escape closes it through onEscape, and closing returns focus to the Quick edit button.

blocks/components/Hooks/useGridFocusHook.name: useGridFocus — Color Swatch Grid
blocks/components/Hooks/useGridFocusHook.description: A color swatch picker in rows of eight with one Tab stop. useGridFocus moves focus with the arrow keys, Home and End, and Ctrl+Home and Ctrl+End. Each swatch is a button, so Enter or a click picks it.

blocks/components/Hooks/useHotkeysHookUs.name: useHotkeys — Search and Help Shortcuts
blocks/components/Hooks/useHotkeysHookUs.description: Page shortcuts registered with useHotkeys: "/" focuses the search field and "?" opens the shortcut help, while typing either character in the field just types it. A switch turns the single-key shortcuts off through isDisabled.

blocks/components/Hooks/useImageModeHook.name: useImageMode — Photo Caption
blocks/components/Hooks/useImageModeHook.description: A photo banner with a caption over the sky. useImageMode samples only the strip under the caption and MediaTheme switches the caption between light and dark text from the result. A Beach photo switch swaps a night photo for a bright beach photo, and while the new photo loads the caption keeps the dark fallback.

blocks/components/Hooks/useInputContaine.name: useInputContainer — Search Field Wrapper
blocks/components/Hooks/useInputContaine.description: A custom search field wrapper with a leading search icon, padding and a trailing Clear button. useInputContainer puts focus in the input when the icon or the padding is clicked, while a click on Clear empties the field without the wrapper taking it over.

blocks/components/Hooks/useInputStatusIc.name: useInputStatusIcon — Coupon Code Status
blocks/components/Hooks/useInputStatusIc.description: A custom bordered coupon-code input whose status affordance comes from useInputStatusIcon. A wrong code shows the error status and SAVE20 shows success.
