Switching the variant moves between a plain glyph with a message below (attached), no icon on the field (detached), and a focusable button whose tooltip keyboard and screen-reader users can reach, with its aria-describedby id returned by the hook (tooltip).

blocks/components/Hooks/useInteractiveRo.name: useInteractiveRole — One Tile, Four Roles
blocks/components/Hooks/useInteractiveRo.description: A polymorphic Tile used four ways: with an href it renders as a link, with an onClick as a button, with neither as plain content, and placed as a Popover trigger it becomes the trigger button through context — the resolution order in one place.

blocks/components/Hooks/useKeyboardHintH.name: useKeyboardHint — Arrow-key Hint
blocks/components/Hooks/useKeyboardHintH.description: A custom five-star rating with one Tab stop calls useKeyboardHint directly: tabbing into it shows a "← → to navigate" hint, the first arrow press dismisses it, and tabbing back in does not show it again.

blocks/components/Hooks/useListFocusHook.name: useListFocus — Recent Files
blocks/components/Hooks/useListFocusHook.description: A "Recent files" list of buttons with keyboard navigation from useListFocus: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move between rows, Home and End jump to the first and last row, focus wraps at the ends, and only one row is in the tab order.

blocks/components/Hooks/useLocaleHookUsa.name: useLocale — Invoice Summary
blocks/components/Hooks/useLocaleHookUsa.description: An invoice summary that formats its date and amount with Intl using the locale from useLocale, so switching the provider from English to German changes "Nov 2, 2026" and "$1,234.50" to "2. Nov. 2026" and "1.234,50 $" with no second locale source.

blocks/components/Hooks/useMergedRefsHoo.name: useMergedRefs — AutoGrowTextArea
blocks/components/Hooks/useMergedRefsHoo.description: An AutoGrowTextArea that forwards the caller's ref and also keeps its own ref to measure scrollHeight. The merged ref attaches both to the same textarea: it resizes itself while a parent button focuses it through the forwarded ref.

blocks/components/Hooks/useOverflowHookU.name: useOverflow — Editor Toolbar
blocks/components/Hooks/useOverflowHookU.description: Resize the card: useOverflow moves the toolbar actions that do not fit into a More menu, and shows them again when the card gets wider.

blocks/components/Hooks/usePressFeedback.name: usePressFeedback — Pressable Card
blocks/components/Hooks/usePressFeedback.description: A Card made pressable with usePressFeedback: its marker and the interactionOverlayStyles backgroundImage overlay go straight on the Card, so a press darkens the card the way every Astryx pressable does; focusOutlineStyles.focusVisible gives it the shared Astryx focus ring for keyboard focus; and a click, Enter or Space flips it.

blocks/components/Hooks/useScrollLockHoo.name: useScrollLock — Full-screen Mobile Menu
blocks/components/Hooks/useScrollLockHoo.description: A custom full-screen menu opened from a Menu button. useScrollLock pins the page behind it while it is open, so the page does not scroll or shift sideways, and closing the menu returns the reader to the same scroll position.

blocks/components/Hooks/useScrollOverflo.name: useScrollOverflow — Filter Strip Edge Fades
blocks/components/Hooks/useScrollOverflo.description: A row of active filters that scrolls sideways. useScrollOverflow reports which edge has hidden filters, and the strip fades only that edge: none while every filter fits, the end at the start, both mid-scroll and the start at the end. Adding or removing a filter updates the fades, and in a right-to-left layout the start edge is on the right.

blocks/components/Hooks/useScrollableAre.name: useScrollableArea — Activity Log Panel
blocks/components/Hooks/useScrollableAre.description: A fixed-height Activity log panel whose entries scroll up and down. useScrollableArea makes the panel a keyboard tab stop only when its entries overflow, reports which edges have more entries so a top or bottom shadow shows only there, and keeps a scroll that reaches the end from scrolling the page. Add entry flips the panel from not scrollable to scrollable.

blocks/components/Hooks/useStreamingText.name: useStreamingText — Streaming Response
blocks/components/Hooks/useStreamingText.description: A chat-style reply card: while the response streams in bursts, useStreamingText reveals it steadily character by character; when streaming ends the full text snaps into place. Regenerate replays the stream.

blocks/components/Hooks/useTranslatorHoo.name: useTranslator — Load More Footer
blocks/components/Hooks/useTranslatorHoo.description: A "Load more" footer under a list that gets its button label and its "Showing 3 of 9" count from the function useTranslator returns, with app message keys supplied per locale through InternationalizationProvider, so switching the provider to French changes both strings.

blocks/components/Hooks/useTreeFocusHook.name: useTreeFocus — Keyboard File Tree
blocks/components/Hooks/useTreeFocusHook.description: A custom file tree built from plain rows with tree roles. useTreeFocus gives it the WAI-ARIA tree keyboard model: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move over the visible rows, ArrowRight opens a folder or moves into it, ArrowLeft closes it or moves to its parent, Home and End jump to the ends, a typed letter jumps to a matching name, Enter opens a file, and only one row is in the tab order.

blocks/components/Hooks/useTypeaheadHook.name: useTypeahead — Type to Focus a Country
blocks/components/Hooks/useTypeaheadHook.displayName: useTypeahead — Type to Focus a Country
blocks/components/Hooks/useTypeaheadHook.description: A country list of buttons with useListFocus arrow keys and useTypeahead type-to-focus. Typing "can" focuses Canada, pressing "b" again and again cycles through Belgium, Brazil and Bulgaria, and "e" finds Éire with the accent ignored. The hook only reports the match through onMatch, and useListFocus moves focus.

blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardHoo.name: useHoverCard — Profile Preview
blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardHoo.description: Custom profile preview using useHoverCard with direct trigger and render control.

blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardInl.name: HoverCard — Definition
blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardInl.description: Shows a term definition on hover within a paragraph. Use for technical terms, jargon, or concepts that some readers may not know, like a glossary built into the text.

blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardInt.name: HoverCard — Link Preview
blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardInt.description: Shows a page summary when hovering a link: title, description, and URL. Use for documentation links, article references, or any URL where a preview helps the user decide whether to click.

blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardPro.name: HoverCard — Profile Preview
blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardPro.description: Shows a user profile summary on hover with name, role, and bio. Use on usernames, avatars, or mentions to let users preview a profile without navigating away.

blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardSho.name: HoverCard
blocks/components/HoverCard/HoverCardSho.description: A hover card that shows a user profile preview when hovering over a trigger button. Starts open for preview.

blocks/components/Icon/IconSemanticColor.name: Icon — Semantic Colors
blocks/components/Icon/IconSemanticColor.description: All semantic icon color variants with labels.

blocks/components/Icon/IconSizes.doc.mjs.name: Icon — Size Variants
blocks/components/Icon/IconSizes.doc.mjs.description: All icon sizes from extra-small to large.

blocks/components/Icon/IconStatusIcons.d.name: Icon — Status Indicators
blocks/components/Icon/IconStatusIcons.d.description: Status list using semantic icons for success, warning, error, and info.

blocks/components/Icon/useIconHookUsage..name: useIcon — Status Row
blocks/components/Icon/useIconHookUsage..description: A custom status row that draws the semantic success, warning and error icons with useIcon. The same row renders under the current theme and under a Theme whose icons override those three, and its icons change with no change to the component.

blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonA.name: IconButton — Action Bar
blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonA.description: Row of ghost icon buttons for a compact action toolbar

blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonF.name: IconButton — Floating
blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonF.description: A floating action button (FAB). The most common floating-button shape is icon-only. Raised here with `elevation="high"`.

blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonL.name: IconButton — Loading State
blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonL.description: Icon buttons that show a loading spinner on click for async feedback

blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonS.name: IconButton
blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonS.description: An icon button with a wrench icon.

blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonT.name: IconButton — With Tooltips
blocks/components/IconButton/IconButtonT.description: Icon buttons with tooltips that explain each action on hover

blocks/components/InfoTip/InfoTipMetricD.name: InfoTip — Metric Definitions
blocks/components/InfoTip/InfoTipMetricD.description: A row of metrics, each label followed by an InfoTip that defines how the value is counted.

blocks/components/InfoTip/InfoTipPermiss.name: InfoTip — Permission Notes
blocks/components/InfoTip/InfoTipPermiss.description: Read-only settings whose labels carry an InfoTip that says who can change each value.

blocks/components/InputGroup/InputGroupB.name: InputGroup — Basic
blocks/components/InputGroup/InputGroupB.description: A currency field with static prefix and suffix addons around a TextInput. Use InputGroupText to clarify units or input format.

blocks/components/InternationalizationPr.name: InternationalizationProvider — Shipped Locale
blocks/components/InternationalizationPr.description: Load a locale catalog shipped by Astryx and re-render InternationalizationProvider with a new locale to update Astryx strings live.

blocks/components/InternationalizationPr.name: InternationalizationProvider — Overrides
blocks/components/InternationalizationPr.description: Override a small number of Astryx strings without providing a full locale catalog.

blocks/components/InternationalizationPr.name: InternationalizationProvider — RTL Direction
blocks/components/InternationalizationPr.description: Toggle text direction with the `dir` prop and watch Astryx components mirror. Pagination flips its prev/next chevrons under RTL. The `dir` prop is passed to both `InternationalizationProvider` (so Astryx components pick it up) and the `VStack` (so the DOM subtree mirrors); both channels stay in sync with no extra wrapper.

blocks/components/Item/ItemBasicItem.doc.name: Item — Basic
blocks/components/Item/ItemBasicItem.doc.description: A basic item with a label, supporting description, and end-aligned timestamp. Use this for simple rows that need consistent text alignment and spacing.

blocks/components/Item/ItemDocumentTabs..name: Item — Document Tabs
blocks/components/Item/ItemDocumentTabs..description: Single-row, horizontally scrollable document switcher with compact selected rows, leading file icons, instant reveal-on-hover close actions with reserved geometry, stable separators, and an add control outside the scroll area. Use for editor tabs, workspace tabs, open documents, files, canvases, or panels.

blocks/components/Item/ItemWithMedia.doc.name: Item — Start Content
blocks/components/Item/ItemWithMedia.doc.description: Items with leading avatars and icons in the startContent slot. Keep start content small so the row stays compact and easy to scan.

blocks/components/Item/ItemWithMetadata..name: Item — Metadata
blocks/components/Item/ItemWithMetadata..description: Status rows with an icon, a title, a short description, and end-aligned metadata such as a timestamp or a status badge, here build, memory, and sync events. Use the endContent slot for counts, status, timestamps, and other secondary row information.

blocks/components/Kbd/KbdInlineInstructi.name: Kbd — Inline Instructions
blocks/components/Kbd/KbdInlineInstructi.description: Keyboard shortcuts rendered inline within instructional text

blocks/components/Kbd/KbdMenuShortcuts.d.name: Kbd — Menu Shortcuts
blocks/components/Kbd/KbdMenuShortcuts.d.description: Menu-style list pairing action labels with their keyboard shortcuts

blocks/components/Kbd/KbdModifierCombos..name: Kbd — Modifier Combinations
blocks/components/Kbd/KbdModifierCombos..description: Modifier combinations and special keys rendered as shortcut badges

blocks/components/Layer/LayerHookUsage.d.name: useLayer — Anchored Layer
blocks/components/Layer/LayerHookUsage.d.description: Low-level anchored overlay rendered with useLayer and a custom surface.

blocks/components/Layout/LayoutBasicCard.name: Layout — Basic Card
blocks/components/Layout/LayoutBasicCard.description: A card layout with header, scrollable content area, and footer with action buttons.

blocks/components/Layout/LayoutContentOn.name: Layout — Content Only
blocks/components/Layout/LayoutContentOn.description: A minimal layout with just a content area inside a card, without header or footer.

blocks/components/Layout/LayoutContentWi.name: Layout — Content Width
blocks/components/Layout/LayoutContentWi.description: A layout using contentWidth to constrain and center content while keeping dividers full-bleed.

blocks/components/Layout/LayoutDualPanel.name: Layout — Dual Panel
blocks/components/Layout/LayoutDualPanel.description: A file browser style layout with start panel for folders, main content for files, and end panel for details.

blocks/components/Layout/LayoutFullBleed.name: Layout — Full Bleed Content
blocks/components/Layout/LayoutFullBleed.description: A layout where content extends edge-to-edge with zero padding, ideal for tables or images.

blocks/components/Layout/LayoutSidebarLa.name: Layout — Sidebar Navigation
blocks/components/Layout/LayoutSidebarLa.description: A settings page layout with a navigation sidebar panel, content area, header, and footer.

blocks/components/LayoutContent/LayoutCo.name: LayoutContent — Basic
blocks/components/LayoutContent/LayoutCo.description: A scrollable main content area below a fixed header. Use LayoutContent inside Layout to get automatic padding and scroll containment for the primary content.

blocks/components/LayoutContent/LayoutCo.name: LayoutContent
blocks/components/LayoutContent/LayoutCo.description: LayoutContent is the scrollable main content area within a Layout, providing automatic padding and scroll containment between the header and footer.

blocks/components/LayoutFooter/LayoutFoo.name: LayoutFooter — Actions
blocks/components/LayoutFooter/LayoutFoo.description: A fixed footer with end-aligned action buttons below scrollable content. Use LayoutFooter inside Layout for persistent actions like Save and Cancel.

blocks/components/LayoutFooter/LayoutFoo.name: LayoutFooter
blocks/components/LayoutFooter/LayoutFoo.description: LayoutFooter is a fixed footer slot within a Layout, pinned to the bottom for persistent actions like form buttons or navigation.

blocks/components/LayoutHeader/LayoutHea.name: LayoutHeader
blocks/components/LayoutHeader/LayoutHea.description: LayoutHeader is a fixed header slot within a Layout, pinned to the top for titles, navigation, and action buttons.

blocks/components/LayoutHeader/LayoutHea.name: LayoutHeader — With Actions
blocks/components/LayoutHeader/LayoutHea.description: A fixed page header with a title and a primary action, above scrollable content. Use LayoutHeader inside Layout for persistent page-level headers.

blocks/components/LayoutPanel/LayoutPane.name: LayoutPanel — Navigation
blocks/components/LayoutPanel/LayoutPane.description: A fixed-width side panel holding a navigation list next to the main content. Use LayoutPanel in the start or end slot of Layout for sidebars.

blocks/components/LayoutPanel/LayoutPane.name: LayoutPanel
blocks/components/LayoutPanel/LayoutPane.description: LayoutPanel is a sidebar slot within a Layout, used for navigation, detail views, or secondary content alongside the main content area.

blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxGalle.name: Lightbox — Gallery
blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxGalle.description: A thumbnail grid that opens a fullscreen gallery. Clicking any thumbnail opens the lightbox at that index. Prev/next navigation lets users browse all images without closing.

blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxHookU.name: useLightbox — Gallery Grid
blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxHookU.description: Photo gallery thumbnail grid using useLightbox for trigger props, keyboard navigation, and open state.

blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxShowc.name: Lightbox
blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxShowc.description: A fullscreen image viewer with caption.

blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxVideo.name: Lightbox — Video
blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxVideo.description: Opens a video in the lightbox. Native browser controls are available. Zoom and pan are disabled for video items.

blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxZoom..name: Lightbox — Zoom
blocks/components/Lightbox/LightboxZoom..description: A lightbox with zoom and pan enabled. Double-click the image to zoom in; drag to pan around. Double-click again or use the close button to exit.

blocks/components/Link/LinkExternalLinks.name: Link — External Links
blocks/components/Link/LinkExternalLinks.description: A vertical list of external links that open in a new tab with an indicator icon.

blocks/components/Link/LinkInlineLink.do.name: Link — Inline Text
blocks/components/Link/LinkInlineLink.do.description: A link embedded within a paragraph of body text.

blocks/components/Link/LinksWithTooltips.name: Link — With Tooltips
blocks/components/Link/LinksWithTooltips.description: Horizontal row of standalone links with descriptive hover tooltips.

blocks/components/Link/useLinkComponentH.name: useLinkComponent — Article Cards
blocks/components/Link/useLinkComponentH.description: A custom Article card renders its title link with the component useLinkComponent resolves: the as prop first, then the nearest LinkProvider, then a native anchor. Inside a LinkProvider wired to a client-side router, the title navigates without a page load and updates the router location. With as="a" the title is a native anchor even inside the provider, and outside the provider it falls back to the next provider up or a native anchor.

blocks/components/Link/useLinkifyHookUsa.name: useLinkify — Links in a Comment Thread
blocks/components/Link/useLinkifyHookUsa.displayName: useLinkify — Links in a Comment Thread
