blocks/components/StatusDot/StatusDotPul.description: Animated pulsing dots for live, processing, and error states.

blocks/components/StatusDot/StatusDotSta.name: StatusDot — Status Indicators
blocks/components/StatusDot/StatusDotSta.description: Labeled status dot list for presence indicators like online, away, and offline.

blocks/components/StatusDot/StatusDotVar.name: StatusDot — Variants
blocks/components/StatusDot/StatusDotVar.description: All five semantic color variants displayed in a row.

blocks/components/Step/StepContent.doc.m.name: Step — Content Slot
blocks/components/Step/StepContent.doc.m.description: Children passed to a Step render below its description, indented to line up with the label rather than the indicator, and stay outside the clickable label area so buttons inside remain their own targets. In a full flow you gate the slot on the step being active. That is what turns a vertical stepper into an expanding one.

blocks/components/Step/StepIndicator.doc.name: Step — Indicator
blocks/components/Step/StepIndicator.doc.description: Everything the indicator prop accepts: the auto default, an always-number badge, a custom ReactNode, and none, each on its own completed Step so the prop is the only difference between them. Every variant occupies the same 16px box, so a step swapping its number for a check as it completes never shifts the label beside it. The last cell shows that a custom node can be live rather than static: a Spinner on a step that is in progress, shaded `inherit` so it picks up the step's own tint like any other glyph.

blocks/components/Step/StepShowcase.doc..name: Step
blocks/components/Step/StepShowcase.doc..description: A single Step, with every part it can render: the indicator, the label with its optional marker and trailing endContent, and the description beneath. A Step never sets its own completed/current state. It declares its index and derives the rest from the parent Stepper, so one Step in one Stepper is a complete example.

blocks/components/Step/StepStates.doc.mj.name: Step — States
blocks/components/Step/StepStates.doc.mj.description: Every state a single Step can land in, each shown as one Step in its own Stepper. Completed, current, and upcoming are derived by comparing the step index against the parent activeStep, so they are never set directly; isDisabled and status are the two a step declares itself. Status is a separate axis from progress, which is why a completed step can still carry a warning.

blocks/components/Stepper/StepperCustomC.name: Stepper — Custom Content
blocks/components/Stepper/StepperCustomC.description: A vertical stepper where each step owns a slice of the page. The content slot takes any node (form fields, a summary panel, a banner), so a stepper is not limited to multi-step forms. Rendering the slot only for the active step is what makes the flow expand one step at a time.

blocks/components/Stepper/StepperIndicat.name: Stepper — Indicator Modes
blocks/components/Stepper/StepperIndicat.description: The indicator prop side by side: none (the bar and label carry the progress on their own), auto (check when done, ring when current, number ahead), always-number, and a custom icon per step.

blocks/components/Stepper/StepperOnTrack.name: Stepper — On-Track Horizontal
blocks/components/Stepper/StepperOnTrack.description: The on-track layout in horizontal orientation: instead of sitting beside the label, each indicator is slotted into the connector itself, so the numbered nodes read as beads on one continuous line. Labels center under their node.

blocks/components/Stepper/StepperOnTrack.name: Stepper — On-Track Vertical
blocks/components/Stepper/StepperOnTrack.description: The on-track layout in vertical orientation: indicators sit inline on a continuous connector rail, with each label and description beside its node. Compare with the separated layout, where the indicator sits alongside its own bar segment instead of on a shared rail.

blocks/components/Stepper/StepperShowcas.name: Stepper — Checkout Progress
blocks/components/Stepper/StepperShowcas.description: The default stepper: a horizontal track where every step owns an equal segment of the progress bar above its label. The default auto indicator resolves itself per step: a check once the step is done, a ring on the current step, a number for the ones still ahead. Click any step to jump.

blocks/components/Stepper/StepperStatus..name: Stepper — Validation Status
blocks/components/Stepper/StepperStatus..description: Semantic status per step in a verification flow: success shows a green check, error a red glyph, accent the in-progress step. Status sets the indicator color and glyph only, never the connector, and is announced to assistive tech as text.

blocks/components/Stepper/StepperWidthRe.name: Stepper — Horizontal Narrow Collapsed
blocks/components/Stepper/StepperWidthRe.description: A narrow horizontal stepper using horizontalOptions. At 320px wide, four steps fall below the 112px minimumStepWidth and collapse into a current-step summary with Previous and Next controls.

blocks/components/Switch/SwitchDisabled..name: Switch — Disabled
blocks/components/Switch/SwitchDisabled..description: Disabled switch with label and description for gated features.

blocks/components/Switch/SwitchSettingsP.name: Switch — Settings Panel
blocks/components/Switch/SwitchSettingsP.description: Settings panel with spread-spaced switches in a card.

blocks/components/Switch/SwitchShowcase..name: Switch
blocks/components/Switch/SwitchShowcase..description: A toggle switch for enabling notifications.

blocks/components/Switch/SwitchWithDescr.name: Switch — With Description
blocks/components/Switch/SwitchWithDescr.description: Toggle with a label and supporting description text.

blocks/components/Switch/SwitchWithStatu.name: Switch — With Status
blocks/components/Switch/SwitchWithStatu.description: Switches with error, warning, and success validation states.

blocks/components/SyntaxTheme/SyntaxThem.name: SyntaxTheme — Dark Preset
blocks/components/SyntaxTheme/SyntaxThem.description: Wrap a code block in SyntaxTheme to apply a dark syntax preset such as Dracula.

blocks/components/SyntaxTheme/SyntaxThem.name: SyntaxTheme — Light Preset
blocks/components/SyntaxTheme/SyntaxThem.description: Use a light syntax preset for code examples that need to sit on light documentation surfaces.

blocks/components/SyntaxTheme/SyntaxThem.name: SyntaxTheme — Compact Preset
blocks/components/SyntaxTheme/SyntaxThem.description: A concise code block rendered with the One Dark Pro syntax preset to show how SyntaxTheme changes highlighting colors without making the page long.

blocks/components/Tab/TabShowcase.doc.mj.name: Tab
blocks/components/Tab/TabShowcase.doc.mj.description: Tab is an individual tab item within a TabList, supporting labels, icons, selected icons, and end content slots.

blocks/components/Tab/TabWithSelectedIco.name: Tab — Selected Icon
blocks/components/Tab/TabWithSelectedIco.description: A tab that changes its icon when selected.

blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsFil.name: TabList — Fill Layout
blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsFil.description: Tabs that stretch to fill the available width with a bottom divider.

blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.name: TabList — With Actions
blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.description: Page header pattern with tabs on the left and action buttons pushed to the right. When hasDivider is true, match the Button size to the TabList size so the tabs and actions align to a shared baseline above the divider.

blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.name: TabList — With Badge
blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.description: Tabs with notification badge counts rendered via endContent. Uses error variant for urgent counts and neutral for informational ones.

blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.name: TabList — With Icons
blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.description: Tabs with leading icons alongside text labels.

blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.name: TabList — With Overflow Menu
blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.description: Tab list with a dropdown menu for additional items that do not fit inline.

blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.name: TabList — With Status Dot
blocks/components/TabList/TabListTabsWit.description: Tabs with status dot indicators rendered via endContent to show live environment health at a glance.

blocks/components/TabMenu/TabMenuBasic.d.name: TabMenu — Basic
blocks/components/TabMenu/TabMenuBasic.d.description: An overflow menu at the end of a TabList that collects secondary tabs behind a dropdown. Use it when there are more tabs than fit comfortably inline.

blocks/components/TabMenu/TabMenuShowcas.name: TabMenu
blocks/components/TabMenu/TabMenuShowcas.description: TabMenu is an overflow menu within a TabList that groups additional tab options into a dropdown, showing the selected option's label as the trigger text.

blocks/components/Table/ColumnResizeHook.name: useTableColumnResize — Draggable Columns
blocks/components/Table/ColumnResizeHook.description: A Table using useTableColumnResize. Drag the right edge of any column header to resize; widths are committed on release. The last proportional column flexes to fill remaining space.

blocks/components/Table/RowsVirtualizati.name: useTableRowsVirtualization - Fixed Height Rows
blocks/components/Table/RowsVirtualizati.description: A Table with 1,000 product rows in a fixed-height viewport. Scroll vertically to mount the visible rows. The caller keeps all data and columns; this hook does not virtualize columns.

blocks/components/Table/StickyColumnsHoo.name: useTableStickyColumns — Pinned Columns
blocks/components/Table/StickyColumnsHoo.description: A Table using useTableStickyColumns to pin the Name column to the start edge and Status to the end edge. Scroll horizontally; pinned columns stay in view with a soft shadow over the scrolling content.

blocks/components/Table/TableBulkActions.name: Table: Bulk Actions
blocks/components/Table/TableBulkActions.description: Controlled row selection with the reusable TableSelectionToolbar rendered in flow above the table. Product actions occupy the logical start; synchronized selection count and complete clear action occupy the logical end.

blocks/components/Table/TableColumnSetti.name: Table — Column Settings
blocks/components/Table/TableColumnSetti.description: Table with a column visibility picker in the toolbar. Toggle columns on and off.

blocks/components/Table/TableFilterableT.name: Table — Popover Filters
blocks/components/Table/TableFilterableT.description: Table with popover filter controls triggered by icons in column headers.

blocks/components/Table/TableFloatingBul.name: Table: Floating Bulk Actions
blocks/components/Table/TableFloatingBul.description: The reusable TableSelectionToolbar inside a capped, self-contained scroll region for a long non-sticky table below metric cards. The caller-owned sticky placement keeps actions 16px from the example scrollport without moving the table when selection changes.

blocks/components/Table/TableGridDivider.name: Table — Grid Dividers
blocks/components/Table/TableGridDivider.description: Compact table with grid dividers showing both row and column borders, suited for dense numeric data.

blocks/components/Table/TableGroupedRows.name: useTableGroupedRows — Collapsible Groups
blocks/components/Table/TableGroupedRows.description: A table grouped into collapsible sections with useTableGroupedRows. Each group gets a full-width header with a chevron, label, and member count; click to collapse/expand.

blocks/components/Table/TableInCard.doc..name: Table — In Card
blocks/components/Table/TableInCard.doc..description: Table composed inside a card with a heading, demonstrating container bleed alignment.

blocks/components/Table/TableInlineFilte.name: Table — Inline Filters
blocks/components/Table/TableInlineFilte.description: Table with inline filter controls rendered directly below each column header.

blocks/components/Table/TableLeadingMark.name: Table — Selection in the Leading Mark
blocks/components/Table/TableLeadingMark.displayName: Table — Selection in the Leading Mark
blocks/components/Table/TableLeadingMark.description: Selection without a checkbox column: each item shows its avatar, and the checkbox takes the avatar slot while a mouse is over it, on keyboard focus, and everywhere once anything is selected; on touch screens it always shows. The state comes from useTableSelectionState, and the checkboxes render in the name column instead of the useTableSelection column, so checked items get no aria-selected or highlight; add them if needed.

blocks/components/Table/TablePaginatedTa.name: Table — Paginated Data
blocks/components/Table/TablePaginatedTa.description: Paginated data table navigating through a larger dataset page by page.

blocks/components/Table/TableResizableTa.name: Table — Resizable Columns
blocks/components/Table/TableResizableTa.description: Table with draggable column resize handles. Drag the right edge of any header to resize.

blocks/components/Table/TableRichCellTab.name: Table — Rich Cell Content
blocks/components/Table/TableRichCellTab.description: Table with rich cell content using Link for emails and Badge for role labels.

blocks/components/Table/TableRowExpansio.name: useTableRowExpansion — Tree Table
blocks/components/Table/TableRowExpansio.description: A tree table using useTableRowExpansion with inherited columns. Child rows use the same columns as parents, indented by depth. Click the chevron or right-click to expand/collapse.

blocks/components/Table/TableRowIndexTab.name: useTableRowIndex — Numbered Rows
blocks/components/Table/TableRowIndexTab.description: A table with a prepended row-number column via useTableRowIndex. Numbering is monospaced, right-aligned, and follows the rows the table renders.

blocks/components/Table/TableRowStatusTa.name: useTableRowStatus - Semantic and Custom Markers
blocks/components/Table/TableRowStatusTa.description: A job table using both row-status paths: status resolves themed semantic glyphs and tones, while color stays a custom paint choice with an optional caller-selected icon or the stable dot.

blocks/components/Table/TableSelectableT.name: Table — Row Selection
blocks/components/Table/TableSelectableT.description: Table with row selection checkboxes and a select-all header checkbox.

blocks/components/Table/TableShowcase.do.name: Table
blocks/components/Table/TableShowcase.do.description: Data-driven table with proportional and pixel column widths and hover highlighting.

blocks/components/Table/TableSortableTab.name: Table — Sortable Columns
blocks/components/Table/TableSortableTab.description: Table with sortable columns, click headers to sort ascending or descending.

blocks/components/Table/TableStripedTabl.name: Table — Striped Rows
blocks/components/Table/TableStripedTabl.description: Table with alternating row colors and hover highlighting for easy scanning.

blocks/components/Table/TableTreeTable.d.name: useTableTreeData: Tree Table
blocks/components/Table/TableTreeTable.d.description: A file-tree table built from nested data. useTableTreeState flattens the tree into the visible rows and owns the expanded set; useTableTreeData draws the per-level indent and the expand/collapse chevron in the tree column. The two hooks are designed to work together, so this one example covers both. hasExpandAllControl adds the expand-all/collapse-all toggle to the tree column header. Collapsed branches are unmounted, not hidden.

blocks/components/Table/useTableColumnSe.name: useTableColumnSettingsState — Column Visibility Picker
blocks/components/Table/useTableColumnSe.description: A Table toolbar with a Columns menu of checkboxes: toggling Email updates active columns, Reset restores defaults, and the config is passed directly to useTableColumnSettings.

blocks/components/Table/useTableSortable.name: useTableSortableState — Multi-Sort Orders
blocks/components/Table/useTableSortable.description: Orders with no sort code of their own: useTableSortableState owns the sort state, returns the sorted orders, and hands useTableSortable a ready config. Click Customer, then Shift-click Total, to sort by customer and then by total within each customer. A line above the orders reads the current sort state from the hook.

blocks/components/Text/TextColors.doc.mj.name: Text — Colors
blocks/components/Text/TextColors.doc.mj.description: All text color options (primary, secondary, disabled, placeholder, active) applied to body text to show their intended use.

blocks/components/Text/TextHeadingLevels.name: Text — Heading Levels
blocks/components/Text/TextHeadingLevels.description: All 6 heading levels (h1 through h6) rendered with Heading to show the full type scale.

blocks/components/Text/TextInline.doc.mj.name: Text — Inline
blocks/components/Text/TextInline.doc.mj.description: Mixing body and code text inline within a single line using the default inline display mode.

blocks/components/Text/TextTruncation.do.name: Text — Truncation
blocks/components/Text/TextTruncation.do.description: Single-line and multi-line text truncation with ellipsis using maxLines in a width-constrained container.

blocks/components/Text/TextTypes.doc.mjs.name: Text — Types
blocks/components/Text/TextTypes.doc.mjs.description: All 5 semantic text types (body, large, label, supporting, code) with their default styling from the theme.

blocks/components/Text/TextWeight.doc.mj.name: Text — Weight
blocks/components/Text/TextWeight.doc.mj.description: The 4 font weight variants (normal, medium, semibold, bold) applied to body text.

blocks/components/Text/TextWordBreak.doc.name: Text — Word Break
blocks/components/Text/TextWordBreak.doc.description: Compares break-word and break-all word break modes on a long unbreakable string.

blocks/components/Text/TextWrap.doc.mjs.name: Text — Wrap
blocks/components/Text/TextWrap.doc.mjs.description: The 4 text-wrap modes (wrap, nowrap, balance, pretty) shown in width-constrained containers.

blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaChara.name: TextArea — Character Count
blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaChara.description: Textareas with maxLength and a live character counter. The counter turns red when the limit is exceeded.

blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaShowc.name: TextArea
blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaShowc.description: A text area with placeholder text.

blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaState.name: TextArea — States
blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaState.description: Required, disabled, and loading textareas side by side. Shows the interactive states the component supports.

blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaValid.name: TextArea — Validation
blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaValid.description: All three status variants (error, warning, and success) with status messages, plus error without a message. Use to show inline validation feedback as the user types.

blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaWithI.name: TextArea — Icon
blocks/components/TextArea/TextAreaWithI.description: Textareas with a leading icon that hints at the expected content, like a chat bubble for messages or a pencil for notes.

blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputIco.name: TextInput — Icon
blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputIco.description: Inputs with a leading icon that hints at the expected content. Use when the icon helps users identify the field faster, like a lock for passwords or an envelope for email.

blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSea.name: TextInput — Search
blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSea.description: Search input with a hidden label, start icon, and clear button. Use for toolbar and header search bars where the icon provides sufficient context.

blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSiz.name: TextInput — Sizes
blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSiz.description: Small, medium, and large inputs side by side. Use small in dense UIs like table filters, medium for most forms, and large for prominent single-field pages.

blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSta.name: TextInput — States
blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSta.description: Error, warning, and success validation states with status messages. Use to show users what went wrong and how to fix it.

blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSta.name: TextInput — Status variant
blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputSta.description: The statusVariant prop controls whether the status message is attached to the bordered input (default, overlapping directly below) or detached from it (floating below as a separate element with spacing).

blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputTyp.name: TextInput — Types
blocks/components/TextInput/TextInputTyp.description: Text, password, and email types plus field-level features: tooltip, required, optional, description, disabled, and loading.

blocks/components/Theme/ThemeApply.doc.m.name: Theme — Apply Theme
blocks/components/Theme/ThemeApply.doc.m.description: Wrap a subtree in Theme to apply a theme to every child component in that region.

blocks/components/Theme/ThemeNested.doc..name: Theme — Nested Theme
blocks/components/Theme/ThemeNested.doc..description: Nested Theme providers let a local region use a different theme without affecting the rest of the page.

blocks/components/Theme/ThemeShowcase.do.name: Theme — Distinct Themes
blocks/components/Theme/ThemeShowcase.do.description: Two visually distinct theme providers wrapping identical content to show how Theme changes the visual treatment of child components.

blocks/components/Theme/ThemeSwitcher.do.name: Theme — Switch Themes
blocks/components/Theme/ThemeSwitcher.do.description: Use state to switch the theme object passed to Theme and preview a different visual treatment.

blocks/components/Theme/useThemeHookUsag.name: useTheme — Token Values
blocks/components/Theme/useThemeHookUsag.description: Read resolved theme token values with useTheme for non-CSS consumers like SVG charts.

blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailDis.name: Thumbnail — Disabled
blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailDis.description: Thumbnails in the disabled state with reduced opacity. The open and remove buttons stay focusable and announced as disabled, and call nothing.

blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailGal.name: Thumbnail — Gallery
blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailGal.description: A row of clickable thumbnails with labels that open a detail view. Use for image attachment lists where users need to preview and manage uploads.

blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailRem.name: Thumbnail — Removable
blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailRem.description: Thumbnails with a remove button overlay. The close button uses APCA luminance detection to stay visible on both dark and light images.

blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailSho.name: Thumbnail
blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailSho.description: A thumbnail with an image and label.

blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailSta.name: Thumbnail — States
blocks/components/Thumbnail/ThumbnailSta.description: All visual states side by side: image loaded, placeholder, skeleton loading, and upload overlay. Demonstrates the full lifecycle of a thumbnail from empty to loaded.

blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputCon.name: TimeInput — Constrained
blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputCon.description: Time inputs with min/max constraints limiting selection to specific windows. Use to prevent out-of-bounds selections for appointments, reservations, or shift scheduling.

blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputFor.name: TimeInput — Formats
blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputFor.description: 12-hour, 24-hour, and seconds formats side by side. Use 12h for US-centric UIs, 24h for international or technical contexts, and seconds for precise timing.

blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputInc.name: TimeInput — Increment
blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputInc.description: Time input with a custom step increment. Arrow keys jump by the specified interval (e.g. 15 minutes) for quick slot-based scheduling.

blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputSho.name: TimeInput
blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputSho.description: A time input that uses the browser/OS picker on touch by default and Astryx typed entry on fine pointers.

blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputSta.name: TimeInput — States
blocks/components/TimeInput/TimeInputSta.description: Default, disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use status messages to give users clear feedback about their time selection.

blocks/components/Timer/TimerFormats.doc.name: Timer — Formats
blocks/components/Timer/TimerFormats.doc.description: Elapsed compact units and stopwatch clock notation shown from the same start time.

blocks/components/Timer/TimerInline.doc..name: Timer — Inline
blocks/components/Timer/TimerInline.doc..description: A Timer composed into status copy while inheriting the surrounding typography.

blocks/components/Timer/TimerTypography..name: Timer — Typography
blocks/components/Timer/TimerTypography..description: Timer using its Timestamp-matched default typography and an emphasized override.

blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampAut.name: Timestamp — Auto
blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampAut.description: Auto format that shows relative time for recent dates and switches to the full date for older ones. The default choice for most use cases.

blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampCol.name: Timestamp — Colors
blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampCol.description: Timestamp rendered in each available color variant: primary, secondary, disabled, and active.

blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampFor.name: Timestamp — Formats
blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampFor.description: All display formats side by side: date, date_time, time, and their system equivalents. Use date and date_time for user-facing UI, system variants for logs and dev tools.

blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampRel.name: Timestamp — Relative
blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampRel.description: Relative time labels from seconds to months ago, with hover tooltips showing the full date. Use in feeds, comment threads, and activity logs.

blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampTim.name: Timestamp — Timezone
blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampTim.description: Timestamps with the timezone abbreviation appended. Enable isTimezoneShown for audiences across time zones, like audit logs or team calendars.

blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampToo.name: Timestamp — Tooltip time zones
blocks/components/Timestamp/TimestampToo.description: Hover tooltips that show one instant across several time zones or formats. Use tooltipEntries when readers must compare zones, like an incident log carrying both the reader's time and the event's origin zone.

blocks/components/Toast/ToastAction.doc..name: Toast — Action
blocks/components/Toast/ToastAction.doc..description: Persistent toasts with a trailing button or link so the user can act on the notification, like undoing a delete or viewing a report.

blocks/components/Toast/ToastDeduplicati.name: Toast — Deduplication
blocks/components/Toast/ToastDeduplicati.description: Prevent duplicate toasts with uniqueID. Use ignore to keep the first toast, or overwrite to replace it with updated content like a progress percentage.

blocks/components/Toast/ToastDismiss.doc.name: Toast — Dismiss
blocks/components/Toast/ToastDismiss.doc.description: Show a persistent toast and dismiss it programmatically using the function returned by useToast. Use for long-running operations that need manual cleanup.

blocks/components/Toast/ToastShowcase.do.name: Toast
blocks/components/Toast/ToastShowcase.do.description: Imperative toast notifications triggered with useToast and rendered in the toast viewport.

blocks/components/Toast/ToastStacking.do.name: Toast — Stacking
blocks/components/Toast/ToastStacking.do.description: Multiple toasts stacking vertically with smooth enter and exit animations. Click repeatedly to see how toasts queue and dismiss.

blocks/components/Toast/ToastTypes.doc.m.name: Toast — Types
blocks/components/Toast/ToastTypes.doc.m.description: Info and error toast variants side by side. Info toasts auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, error toasts persist until the user dismisses them.

blocks/components/Toast/useToastHookUsag.name: useToast — Settings Saved
blocks/components/Toast/useToastHookUsag.description: Shows a toast from the function useToast returns: a "Settings saved" confirmation with an Undo action, a uniqueID so pressing the button again replaces the toast instead of stacking another, and an error toast when the request fails.

blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.name: ToggleButton — Color
blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.description: Toggle buttons with colored icons in the pressed state. Shows accent-colored toolbar formatting and semantic reaction colors (yellow star, red heart, blue bookmark).

blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.name: ToggleButton — Group
blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.description: Toggle button groups in single-select and multi-select modes. Single selection acts as a view mode switcher; multiple selection forms a formatting toolbar.

blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.name: ToggleButton — Icon Swap
blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.description: Icon-only toggle buttons that swap between outline and solid icons when pressed. Use for actions like favorite, bookmark, or mute where the icon itself communicates the state.

blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.name: ToggleButton — Label
blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.description: Toggle buttons with visible text labels that show a font weight shift on press. Use when the icon alone is not enough to communicate the action.

blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.name: ToggleButton — States
blocks/components/ToggleButton/ToggleBut.description: Default, pressed, disabled, and loading states of a standalone toggle button. Shows how visual treatment changes across states.

blocks/components/ToggleButtonGroup/Togg.name: ToggleButtonGroup
blocks/components/ToggleButtonGroup/Togg.description: ToggleButtonGroup manages a set of ToggleButtons with single-select or multi-select behavior for options like view modes or filters.

blocks/components/ToggleButtonGroup/Togg.name: ToggleButtonGroup — Vertical
blocks/components/ToggleButtonGroup/Togg.description: A vertically stacked ToggleButtonGroup using the vertical orientation, shown with both single-select and multi-select behavior, ideal for sidebar-style option lists and vertical toolbars.

blocks/components/Token/TokenClickable.d.name: Token — Clickable
blocks/components/Token/TokenClickable.d.description: Interactive tokens that respond to clicks. Use for toggleable filters or tokens that open a detail view when selected.

blocks/components/Token/TokenColors.doc..name: Token — Colors
blocks/components/Token/TokenColors.doc..description: All 11 color variants in default and disabled states. Use color to categorize entities or convey status at a glance.

blocks/components/Token/TokenEndContent..name: Token — End Content
blocks/components/Token/TokenEndContent..description: Tokens with trailing content like a count badge or status indicator after the label. Use for notification counts, item quantities, or compact status info.

blocks/components/Token/TokenIcon.doc.mj.name: Token — Icon
blocks/components/Token/TokenIcon.doc.mj.description: Tokens with a leading icon that identifies the entity type. Use when the icon helps users recognize the token category faster, like a user icon for people or a tag icon for labels.

blocks/components/Token/TokenRemovable.d.name: Token — Removable
blocks/components/Token/TokenRemovable.d.description: Tokens with a dismiss button for selections the user can undo. Use in multi-select fields, active filters, or any list of user-chosen items.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerCle.name: Tokenizer — Clear
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerCle.description: Tokenizer with a built-in clear-all button for bulk removal of all selected tokens. On touch screens, clear through the sheet's Clear all.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerCre.name: Tokenizer — Creatable
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerCre.description: Free-text tokenizer for creating custom tags and a combined create-or-search pattern. Use when users need to enter values that may not exist in a predefined list.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerEnd.name: Tokenizer — End Content
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerEnd.description: Tokenizer with an action button in the end slot. Use for inline actions like applying selections alongside the input.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerIco.name: Tokenizer — Icon
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerIco.description: Tokenizer with a leading search icon to visually reinforce the search behavior.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerMax.name: Tokenizer — Max Entries
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerMax.description: Tokenizer with a maximum selection limit. The input hides automatically when the limit is reached, preventing further additions.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerOve.name: Tokenizer — Overflow
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerOve.description: Tokenizer with overflow truncation when unfocused. Inline mode pushes content down on expand; layer mode overlays without shifting layout. Overflow modes apply to the inline field.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerSho.name: Tokenizer
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerSho.description: A tokenizer with preset tags and search source.

blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerSta.name: Tokenizer — States
blocks/components/Tokenizer/TokenizerSta.description: Tokenizer in disabled, error, warning, and success states. Use to communicate validation feedback or lock a selection from editing.

blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarBulkAct.name: Toolbar — Bulk Actions
blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarBulkAct.description: A compact toolbar with the muted variant for showing bulk selection actions. Use when the user selects multiple items in a list or table and needs quick access to batch operations.

blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarCardHea.name: Toolbar — Card Header
blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarCardHea.description: A toolbar as a card header with a left-aligned title and icon actions on the right. Use Toolbar instead of LayoutHeader when your card header has interactive actions; Toolbar adds start/end slot layout, keyboard navigation, and automatic size cascading. If the header is just a title with no actions, a LayoutHeader or Section is enough.

blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarSizes.d.name: Toolbar — Sizes
blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarSizes.d.description: Small, medium, and large toolbars side by side. The size prop cascades to child buttons and inputs automatically. Use small in dense UIs like cards, medium for most cases, and large for spacious layouts.

blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarTableFi.name: Toolbar — Table Filter
blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarTableFi.description: Filter bar above a table: a search box leads the row, each field beside it is a closed trigger that doubles as its own filter chip — the bare field name unset, the whole clause once set — and the clauses fold from the end into a count as the row narrows, followed by a live result count, a clear all, and a column picker. Use to search, filter, and narrow flat rows of records such as jobs, orders, tickets, or users.

blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarThreeSl.name: Toolbar — Three Slot
blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarThreeSl.description: A toolbar with start, center, and end content using the three-column grid layout. Use when you need a centered title or heading with navigation and actions on either side.

blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarWithTab.name: Toolbar — Tab Navigation
blocks/components/Toolbar/ToolbarWithTab.description: A toolbar with tabs in the start slot and an action button at the end. Use as a card or section header when content is split into tabs with a primary action alongside.

blocks/components/Tooltip/TooltipActionB.name: Tooltip — Action Bar
blocks/components/Tooltip/TooltipActionB.description: Tooltips on an action button bar with contextual descriptions.

blocks/components/Tooltip/TooltipHookUsa.name: Tooltip — Hook Usage
blocks/components/Tooltip/TooltipHookUsa.description: Tooltip using the useTooltip hook for programmatic control.

blocks/components/Tooltip/TooltipInlineT.name: Tooltip — Inline Text
blocks/components/Tooltip/TooltipInlineT.description: Tooltips on inline text terms for definitions.

blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavCenteredN.name: TopNav — Centered Navigation
blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavCenteredN.description: Navigation layout with center-aligned nav items flanked by a logo heading and end actions.

blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavEnterpris.name: TopNav — Enterprise Dashboard
blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavEnterpris.description: Full-featured navigation bar with icon-labeled nav items, search, notifications, and a primary CTA.

blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavHoverMenu.name: TopNav — Hover Menu
blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavHoverMenu.description: Navigation bar with a hover-triggered dropdown menu showing product items with icons and descriptions.

blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavMegaMenu..name: TopNav — Mega Menu
blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavMegaMenu..description: Marketing-style navigation with a full-width mega menu featuring product items and a promotional featured card.

blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavMultipleD.name: TopNav — Multiple Dropdowns
blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavMultipleD.description: Navigation bar with multiple hover-triggered dropdown menus that auto-close when switching between them.

blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavWithLogo..name: TopNav — With Logo
blocks/components/TopNav/TopNavWithLogo..description: Navigation bar with a branded logo icon, heading link, nav items, and a profile action.

blocks/components/TopNavHeading/TopNavHe.name: TopNavHeading — Basic
blocks/components/TopNavHeading/TopNavHe.description: A product heading with a logo inside a TopNav, linked to the home page. Use as the leading brand element of a top navigation bar.

blocks/components/TopNavHeading/TopNavHe.name: TopNavHeading
blocks/components/TopNavHeading/TopNavHe.description: Demonstrates TopNavHeading with a logo and text, both as a plain display and as a clickable link.

blocks/components/TopNavItem/TopNavItemB.name: TopNavItem — Basic
blocks/components/TopNavItem/TopNavItemB.description: Navigation links inside a TopNav with one item marked as selected. Use for top-level pages of an application.

blocks/components/TopNavItem/TopNavItemS.name: TopNavItem
blocks/components/TopNavItem/TopNavItemS.description: Demonstrates TopNavItem with selected, icon, disabled, and default states.

blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenu/TopNavM.name: TopNavMegaMenu — Basic
blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenu/TopNavM.description: A mega menu trigger inside a TopNav that opens a panel of rich link items. Use when a navigation section has multiple destinations worth describing.

blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenu/TopNavM.name: TopNavMegaMenu
blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenu/TopNavM.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenu with items and a featured card in the mega menu panel.

blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuFeatured.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard — Basic
blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuFeatured.description: A promotional card with a title, description, and call-to-action link. Pass it to the featured slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to highlight announcements.

blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuFeatured.name: TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard
blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuFeatured.displayName: Top Nav Mega Menu Featured Card
blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuFeatured.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuFeaturedCard with a title, description, and CTA link inside a mega menu.

blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuItem/Top.name: TopNavMegaMenuItem — Basic
blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuItem/Top.description: Rich link items with an icon, title, and description. Use inside the items slot of a TopNavMegaMenu to describe each destination.

blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuItem/Top.name: TopNavMegaMenuItem
blocks/components/TopNavMegaMenuItem/Top.description: Demonstrates TopNavMegaMenuItem with icons, titles, and descriptions inside a mega menu.

blocks/components/TopNavMenu/TopNavMenuB.name: TopNavMenu — Basic
blocks/components/TopNavMenu/TopNavMenuB.description: A dropdown menu inside a TopNav built from an items array with icons and descriptions. Use to group related destinations under a single trigger.

blocks/components/TopNavMenu/TopNavMenuS.name: TopNavMenu
blocks/components/TopNavMenu/TopNavMenuS.description: Demonstrates TopNavMenu with a hover-triggered dropdown containing items with icons and descriptions.

blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListFileT.name: TreeList — File Tree With Icons
blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListFileT.description: File browser tree with folder and document icons distinguishing directories from files.

blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListInter.name: TreeList — Interactive Settings
blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListInter.description: Settings tree with clickable items and a documentation link.

blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListMailb.name: TreeList — Mailbox Tree
blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListMailb.description: Email folder tree with unread badge counts.

blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListNavig.name: TreeList — Navigation Tree
blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListNavig.description: Navigation tree with a selected item for the current page.

blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListVaria.name: Tree List — Variants
blocks/components/TreeList/TreeListVaria.description: The `variant` prop controls whether hierarchy guide lines are shown: `lineGuides` (default) draws connector lines between parent and child rows, while `noGuides` relies on indentation alone. It is orthogonal to `density`, which controls spacing.

blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadLim.name: Typeahead — Limited Results
blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadLim.description: Typeahead with a capped dropdown showing at most three results.

blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadSea.name: Typeahead — Search Field
blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadSea.description: Search input with icon and suggestions on focus.

blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadWit.name: Typeahead — With Helper Text
blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadWit.description: Typeahead with a description below the label.

blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadWit.name: Typeahead — With Validation
blocks/components/Typeahead/TypeaheadWit.description: Typeahead with an error validation message.

blocks/components/TypeaheadItem/Typeahea.name: TypeaheadItem — Basic
blocks/components/TypeaheadItem/Typeahea.description: A typeahead whose results are rendered with TypeaheadItem, adding a secondary description below each label. Use inside renderItem to keep custom results visually consistent.

blocks/components/TypeaheadItem/Typeahea.name: TypeaheadItem
blocks/components/TypeaheadItem/Typeahea.description: Typeahead with custom item rendering using TypeaheadItem for avatars and descriptions.

blocks/components/VStack/VStackBasic.doc.name: VStack — Basic
blocks/components/VStack/VStackBasic.doc.description: A heading and paragraphs stacked vertically with a consistent gap. Use VStack whenever siblings should flow top to bottom with even spacing.

blocks/components/VStack/VStackShowcase..name: VStack
blocks/components/VStack/VStackShowcase..description: Demonstrates VStack arranging items vertically with different gaps.

blocks/components/VisuallyHidden/Visuall.name: VisuallyHidden — Live Region
blocks/components/VisuallyHidden/Visuall.description: A polite aria-live region announces visual-only state changes to assistive technology.

blocks/components/VisuallyHidden/Visuall.name: VisuallyHidden — Structural Heading
blocks/components/VisuallyHidden/Visuall.description: Give a visually implicit section an accessible name so screen-reader users can navigate to it.

blocks/components/VisuallyHidden/Visuall.name: VisuallyHidden — Supplementary Context
blocks/components/VisuallyHidden/Visuall.description: Stat cards whose trend arrows get screen-reader-only text, so a change like +12% is read as an increase from last month. Use to make terse visual data accessible.

blocks/components/createAnimator/Animato.name: createAnimator — Playing cards in plain JavaScript
blocks/components/createAnimator/Animato.displayName: createAnimator — Playing cards in plain JavaScript
blocks/components/createAnimator/Animato.description: The playing card from the useAnimator example, built in plain JavaScript with createAnimator and pointer events: it follows a drag, springs back on a gentle release, flies off with momentum on a quick flick, and a button discards it from the keyboard. React only mounts it.

blocks/components/createDragToSnapPoints.name: createDragToSnapPoints — Playing card in plain JavaScript
blocks/components/createDragToSnapPoints.displayName: createDragToSnapPoints — Playing card in plain JavaScript
blocks/components/createDragToSnapPoints.description: The three-place playing card from the useDragToSnapPoints example, built in plain JavaScript with createDragToSnapPoints: a sideways drag settles it on the nearest place or the next after a flick, buttons settle it from the keyboard, and a live region announces the place. React only mounts it.

blocks/components/useAnimator/AnimatorPl.name: useAnimator — Playing cards
blocks/components/useAnimator/AnimatorPl.description: A playing card that follows a drag: a gentle release springs it back on its release velocity, and a quick flick throws it away with momentum before the next card is dealt. A Discard button moves it off from the keyboard, fading it in place under Reduce Motion, and the discard is announced. Built only on the public useAnimator hook.

blocks/components/useDragToSnapPoints/Dr.name: useDragToSnapPoints — Playing card on three places
blocks/components/useDragToSnapPoints/Dr.displayName: useDragToSnapPoints — Playing card on three places
blocks/components/useDragToSnapPoints/Dr.description: A playing card that a sideways drag moves between three places: a slow release settles on the nearest, a quick flick carries to the next, and a release moving back returns where it started. Buttons settle it from the keyboard, and the new place is announced. Built only on the public useDragToSnapPoints hook.

blocks/components/usePanGesture/PanDragg.name: usePanGesture — A draggable box
blocks/components/usePanGesture/PanDragg.description: The smallest pan example, in two forms side by side: the usePanGesture hook and the createPanGesture factory. The factory takes any element, React or not. Each card names its API, follows a drag from a finger, a mouse or a pen, and springs back, with the same StyleX styles. A starting point for a draggable tile, a swipe or any drag-and-release gesture.

blocks/components/usePanGesture/PanPlayi.name: usePanGesture — A playing card (advanced)
blocks/components/usePanGesture/PanPlayi.description: An advanced usePanGesture example: a playing card follows a drag, settles back on a gentle release and flies off on a quick flick, while a Discard button deals the next card from the keyboard and announces it. Drag, settle and throw are StyleX styles driven by React state. A pattern for swipe-to-dismiss, card decks and flick gestures.

pages/ai-chat-landing/template.doc.mjs.name: AI Chat Landing
pages/ai-chat-landing/template.doc.mjs.description: Zero-state entry surface centered on a single composer with suggestion chips instead of history, sized for the moment before any content exists. The empty counterpart to a transcript.

pages/ai-chat/template.doc.mjs.name: AI Chat Conversation
pages/ai-chat/template.doc.mjs.description: Transcript of alternating turns carrying mixed rich content inline (markdown, code blocks, collapsible tool-call output) beside a resizable artifact panel that holds generated output while the stream keeps scrolling.

pages/blank/template.doc.mjs.name: Blank
pages/blank/template.doc.mjs.description: Bare scaffold: one heading slot, one empty content region, no navigation and no chrome. The starting point when every other layout imposes more structure than wanted.

pages/canvas-editor/template.doc.mjs.name: Canvas Editor
pages/canvas-editor/template.doc.mjs.description: Layered artboard workspace: document tabs over a layer rail, a fixed-size frame you zoom on a muted backdrop, and an inspector of position, type, and filter fields that retargets to the selected layer. Objects hold a coordinate rather than reflowing, so moving one never moves another.

pages/centered-hero/template.doc.mjs.name: Centered Hero
pages/centered-hero/template.doc.mjs.description: Symmetrical centered stack (headline, short blurb, paired call-to-action buttons) resting on one wide full-bleed picture, with nothing on either flank competing.

pages/checkout-wizard/template.doc.mjs.name: Checkout Wizard
pages/checkout-wizard/template.doc.mjs.description: Multi-step checkout, cart, order, and payment wizard with a running summary that recalculates as answers change. It adapts to its host width, renders the summary first on narrow surfaces, validates every forward path, and completes locally without sending payment.

pages/classic-gallery/template.doc.mjs.name: Classic Gallery
pages/classic-gallery/template.doc.mjs.description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place. Regular rhythm, unlike the variable-height masonry variant.

pages/contact-form/template.doc.mjs.name: Contact Form
pages/contact-form/template.doc.mjs.description: Flat single-column form mixing control types (text, pill toggles, dropdowns, long free-text) landing on one full-width submit. No steps, no branching, no summary rail.

pages/course-detail/template.doc.mjs.name: Course Detail
pages/course-detail/template.doc.mjs.description: Long-form sales page for a single offering, in two columns — read the pitch, then enroll from a sticky rail. The main column holds a preview poster with a fact row, an about block with skill chips, a module syllabus whose sections collapse module by module, an instructor card, reviews with a scored-aspects panel, and a FAQ; the rail holds the price, a self-paced or cohort start picker, and a weekly-pace slider that computes a finish date. The shape for any offering with a curriculum and a purchase panel — a course, class, masterclass, bootcamp, workshop, or training.

pages/dashboard-alert-rail/template.doc..name: Service Monitoring Dashboard
pages/dashboard-alert-rail/template.doc..description: Always-on analytics with a triage rail: status-colored tiles with sparklines, multi-series time charts over a switchable window, and an independently scrolling alert column that folds into the content when narrow.

pages/dashboard-cohort-funnel/template.d.name: Funnel & Cohort Dashboard
pages/dashboard-cohort-funnel/template.d.description: Analytics for sequence and retention questions, pairing two shapes a plain dashboard cannot hold: a staged funnel where each step reads as drop-off against the one before, and a two-axis cohort matrix rendered as a heatmap.

pages/dashboard-comparison/template.doc..name: Data Dashboard
pages/dashboard-comparison/template.doc..description: Comparison-heavy analytics behind a persistent filter bar: tiles that each carry an inline sparkline and several period-over-period deltas, then segmented breakdowns underneath. Every number is shown against another number.

pages/dashboard-composition/template.doc.name: Portfolio Dashboard
pages/dashboard-composition/template.doc.description: Analytics for a value-over-time question: balance and change tiles above a stacked area chart of composition through time, closing on a ranked table of the largest contributors.

pages/dashboard-progress/template.doc.mj.name: Project Status Dashboard
pages/dashboard-progress/template.doc.mj.description: Status analytics mixing progress and time-axis shapes: a completion donut, a horizontal timeline of dated bars against a today marker, a per-owner table with progress and status, an at-risk list, and a burndown.

pages/dashboard-scorecard/template.doc.m.name: Executive Summary Dashboard
pages/dashboard-scorecard/template.doc.m.description: Report-shaped analytics with a prose rail beside the charts: a scorecard of headline numbers with period deltas and status coloring, goal-attainment bars, a trend grid, and a written commentary column that folds beneath the content when narrow.

pages/dashboard/template.doc.mjs.name: Analytics Dashboard
pages/dashboard/template.doc.mjs.description: Three-band analytics: a row of headline tiles, then charts, then supporting tables, all re-reading from one global filter bar. Breadth over depth, a summary surface rather than a drill-down.

pages/detail-page/template.doc.mjs.name: Order Detail
pages/detail-page/template.doc.mjs.description: Single-record detail in two columns: a summary header with status and actions, a repeating line-item list, a totals block that sums it, and a chronological activity timeline in the rail. The shape for any record holding children plus a history: a customer order with shipping, an invoice, a transaction, or a job.

pages/documentation-design/template.doc..name: Documentation Design
pages/documentation-design/template.doc..description: Reference article alternating prose with live rendered examples: an interactive preview, a property table, paired do and don't comparisons, and copyable code blocks.

pages/documentation-technical/template.d.name: Documentation Technical
pages/documentation-technical/template.d.description: Reference article ordered as sequential numbered steps with code at each stage, plus callout cards for prerequisites and onward links. A linear walkthrough rather than a browsable reference.

pages/documentation/template.doc.mjs.name: Documentation Catalog
pages/documentation/template.doc.mjs.description: Reference landing that is pure wayfinding: a banner above a grid of category cards linking into sections, with no article content on the surface itself.

pages/editor/template.doc.mjs.name: Page Editor
pages/editor/template.doc.mjs.description: Three-pane authoring workspace: a source palette on one flank, a live canvas in the middle, and an inspector that retargets to whatever is selected. Drag and drop to reorder, edit to see it render immediately.

pages/file-explorer/template.doc.mjs.name: File Explorer
pages/file-explorer/template.doc.mjs.description: Hierarchical browser that drills through nested levels as adjacent columns rather than replacing the list each time, with breadcrumb history, switchable list and grid density, and a metadata pane for the selected node.

pages/form-two-column/template.doc.mjs.name: Two-column Form
pages/form-two-column/template.doc.mjs.description: Form split into two columns beneath a hero header: inputs on one flank, a persistent context panel opposite that stays put while the fields scroll. Flat, single submit, no steps.

pages/form-wizard-dialog/template.doc.mj.name: Dialog Wizard
pages/form-wizard-dialog/template.doc.mj.description: Step through a short flow in a dialog, overlay, or popup launched from the page underneath, which stays where it was. Compact step markers and a pinned action row inside a constrained width, rather than the full page a wizard usually gets. Best for two to four short steps — setup, invite, schedule, onboarding — where losing the context underneath would cost more than the flow is worth.

pages/form-wizard-inline/template.doc.mj.name: Inline Wizard
pages/form-wizard-inline/template.doc.mj.description: Accordion wizard stacking every step in one column: the active step expands in place while finished ones collapse to a single line carrying their result and a way back in. Steps that run themselves expand into a nested stepper that ticks check by check and halts the column where one fails. Best when later steps depend on what earlier ones decided.

pages/form-wizard-vertical/template.doc..name: Vertical Wizard
pages/form-wizard-vertical/template.doc..description: Multi-step wizard with the steps in a fixed left rail that stays visible while the form scrolls, plus a side panel whose guidance follows the focused field. Suits long or unequal steps carrying uploads, previews, and dense review metadata. As width tightens the guidance drops first, then the rail rotates into a horizontal stepper above the form.

pages/form-wizard/template.doc.mjs.name: Form Wizard
pages/form-wizard/template.doc.mjs.description: Linear multi-step form that moves through one panel at a time, with a horizontal progress track pinned above rather than running down a rail, so every step keeps the full content width for its fields. Only the current step renders, unlike an accordion where each section expands into one long scrolling form. Each advance is validated, and a step left broken stays flagged to jump back to.

pages/gallery-hero/template.doc.mjs.name: Gallery Hero
pages/gallery-hero/template.doc.mjs.description: Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set.

pages/ide/template.doc.mjs.name: IDE
pages/ide/template.doc.mjs.description: Dense multi-pane workspace of resizable, collapsible regions: a hierarchy tree on one flank, tabbed documents in the middle, a docked drawer along the bottom, an inspector opposite. Drag a divider to resize or collapse any of them.

pages/incident-console/template.doc.mjs.name: Incident Console
pages/incident-console/template.doc.mjs.description: Dense row queue with an inspector: severity-coded rows grouped by status, a saved-search filter bar, a segmented status control, and a resizable detail pane for the selected row. Rows, not cards, sized for scanning volume.

pages/kanban-board/template.doc.mjs.name: Kanban Board
pages/kanban-board/template.doc.mjs.description: Horizontal lanes of draggable cards where the column itself is the status, so drag and drop between lanes is the state change. Fixed columns, variable-height cards.

pages/library/template.doc.mjs.name: Card Grid
pages/library/template.doc.mjs.description: Searchable, browsable card grid with filter tabs and a real empty state: uniform tiles organized by topic, narrowing in place, with no detail surface behind them.

pages/login-card/template.doc.mjs.name: Login Card
pages/login-card/template.doc.mjs.description: Credential form inside an elevated centered card, third-party provider buttons separated from the fields by a divider, secondary sign-up and legal links beneath.

pages/login-split/template.doc.mjs.name: Login Split
pages/login-split/template.doc.mjs.description: Credential form filling one half of a two-pane split, full-bleed media holding the other. Same fields as the card variant, but the layout carries brand imagery.

pages/login-sso/template.doc.mjs.name: Login SSO
pages/login-sso/template.doc.mjs.description: Progressive credential flow that branches on input: the email domain resolves an identity provider and redirects, with a password path as fallback. Two-stage rather than one form.

pages/login/template.doc.mjs.name: Basic Login
pages/login/template.doc.mjs.description: Minimal centered credential form on a plain ground: two fields and a submit, nothing competing for attention. The least-chrome entry surface.

pages/messaging-shell/template.doc.mjs.name: Messaging Shell
pages/messaging-shell/template.doc.mjs.description: Four-column nested navigation narrowing left to right (team workspace, channel list, message stream, thread panel) where each column scopes the next. Dense rows, zero cards.

pages/mixed-gallery/template.doc.mjs.name: Mixed Gallery
pages/mixed-gallery/template.doc.mjs.description: Masonry grid of variable-height tiles that pack against each other instead of cropping to a shared ratio, captioned per tile. Irregular rhythm, unlike the uniform gallery.

pages/payment-form/template.doc.mjs.name: Checkout Form
pages/payment-form/template.doc.mjs.description: Long sectioned form running beside a summary that stays visible while the fields scroll and recalculates as they change, ending on a terminal confirm of the total. Sections run contact, address, delivery choice, then card details.

pages/product-detail/template.doc.mjs.name: Product Detail
pages/product-detail/template.doc.mjs.description: Single-item detail pairing a media gallery with a selection column: variant swatches, a quantity stepper, primary and secondary commit actions, and collapsible specification sections below.

pages/product-gallery/template.doc.mjs.name: Product Gallery
pages/product-gallery/template.doc.mjs.description: Uniform card grid where every tile carries media, title, supporting line, and a price. Browse-to-select only, with no filtering and no detail surface.

pages/settings-dialog/template.doc.mjs.name: Settings Dialog
pages/settings-dialog/template.doc.mjs.description: Preferences inside a modal container with searchable section navigation, so configuration happens without leaving whatever is underneath. Grouped toggles, live preview of appearance choices, rebindable shortcuts.

pages/settings-sidebar/template.doc.mjs.name: Settings Panels
pages/settings-sidebar/template.doc.mjs.description: Preferences split into nav-switched panels: a persistent section list swaps the pane beside it, and rows edit in place rather than opening a separate form.

pages/settings/template.doc.mjs.name: Settings Form
pages/settings/template.doc.mjs.description: Preferences as one continuously scrolling form, sections stacked in order with no navigation between them. The simplest settings shape: everything reachable by scrolling.

pages/shell-nav/template.doc.mjs.name: Shell Nav
pages/shell-nav/template.doc.mjs.description: Application frame combining both navigation axes: a top menu bar with command-palette search over a resizable hierarchy rail, wrapping placeholder content. For when one axis is not enough.

pages/shell-side-nav/template.doc.mjs.name: Side Nav
pages/shell-side-nav/template.doc.mjs.description: Application frame with a single collapsible, resizable left rail carrying grouped history and search, wrapping the main content. Vertical navigation only, no top bar.

pages/shell-top-nav/template.doc.mjs.name: Top Nav
pages/shell-top-nav/template.doc.mjs.description: Application frame with horizontal navigation only: a centered bar whose items open full-width mega-menu panels, over placeholder content that keeps the entire width.

pages/side-gallery/template.doc.mjs.name: Side Gallery
pages/side-gallery/template.doc.mjs.description: Asymmetric split section: a copy column of headline, supporting text, and links held against a clustered image collage opposite. Deliberately off-balance, unlike the centered hero.

pages/table-collapsible/template.doc.mjs.name: Collapsible Table
pages/table-collapsible/template.doc.mjs.description: Several tables on one page, each in a collapsible card with its own columns — for groups that do not share a schema, where one table would stand full of empty cells. One time range drives them all, and rows expand into a history chart. Accounts, integrations, sections, sort, expand, or collapse.

pages/table-comparison/template.doc.mjs.name: Comparison Table
pages/table-comparison/template.doc.mjs.description: Transposed matrix that puts candidates in the columns and criteria in grouped rows, with a pinned label column that survives horizontal scroll, columns you can swap or add, and best-in-row marks you can toggle. Compare, comparison, matrix, spec sheet, feature grid, pricing table, benchmark, frozen column, sticky column, or side-by-side.

pages/table-filter/template.doc.mjs.name: Filterable Table
pages/table-filter/template.doc.mjs.description: Flat row collection built around progressive filtering: a token bar that escalates into full query syntax, saved views that persist a filter set, column and grouping options, and a resizable detail pane.

pages/table-grouped/template.doc.mjs.name: Grouped Table
pages/table-grouped/template.doc.mjs.description: Row collection bundled into collapsible sections with per-group counts, so a long list reads as a handful of blocks that expand and collapse. Query filtering and a resizable inspector for the selected row.

pages/table-inbox/template.doc.mjs.name: Inbox Table
pages/table-inbox/template.doc.mjs.description: Two-pane message queue: the table indexes a reading pane rather than being the destination, with a divider you drag to resize. Rows stack when the table narrows, not the window; threads read as collapsible messages; replying opens a composer that leaves the list live.

pages/table-page/template.doc.mjs.name: Searchable Table
pages/table-page/template.doc.mjs.description: Flat table of uniform rows under a block of record-level facts, narrowed three ways at once — a full-text search box, a scope toggle, and per-column popovers — with sortable and filterable columns, per-row hover detail, and totals derived from the visible rows that flag themselves as partial while a filter is on. The shape for one homogeneous list, not nested rows or groups with their own columns.

pages/table-tree/template.doc.mjs.name: Tree Table
pages/table-tree/template.doc.mjs.description: Hierarchical table where every parent row rolls up from its children — a code repository whose folders show the newest commit beneath them, beside a detail sidebar and a rendered README. Columns resize, siblings sort within their own level, arrow keys walk the rows, and search prunes the tree to matching branches.

pages/table/template.doc.mjs.name: Simple Table
pages/table/template.doc.mjs.description: Flat row collection where columns sort, rows select into a bulk-action toolbar, and each row carries an overflow menu. Sortable but ungrouped, with no detail pane, the baseline shape.

pages/theme-showcase/template.doc.mjs.name: Theme Showcase
pages/theme-showcase/template.doc.mjs.description: Multi-surface comparison shell: preview palettes, typography, icons and control states across a storefront, checkout, chat and inventory on one responsive canvas. A theme preview and design-system showcase, with an embeddable content view for an existing app shell.

pages/work-item-detail/template.doc.mjs.name: Work Item Detail
pages/work-item-detail/template.doc.mjs.description: Single work-item detail in two columns: a title with a status selector, a description, a subtask checklist with progress, an attachments block, and a comment and activity feed in the main column, plus a property rail with assignee, dates, labels, and linked items. The shape for any tracked item with children, properties, and a comment history — a task, ticket, issue, story, bug, card, request, or work item.

themes/butter/butterTheme.doc.mjs.name: butter
themes/butter/butterTheme.doc.mjs.description: Warm, creamy yellows with a friendly blue accent. Playful enough for consumer surfaces, soft enough to stay readable.

themes/chocolate/chocolateTheme.doc.mjs.name: chocolate
themes/chocolate/chocolateTheme.doc.mjs.description: Warm chocolate theme for Astryx — rich brown palette with Fraunces headings, Albert Sans body, and Lucide icons

themes/gothic/gothicTheme.doc.mjs.name: gothic
themes/gothic/gothicTheme.doc.mjs.description: Deep blue-grays and a signature display serif. Dramatic and editorial, for surfaces that want to be remembered.

themes/matcha/matchaTheme.doc.mjs.name: matcha
themes/matcha/matchaTheme.doc.mjs.description: Earthy greens with a calm, organic feel. Naturalistic and grounded, great for wellness or content-first apps.

themes/neutral/neutralTheme.doc.mjs.name: neutral
themes/neutral/neutralTheme.doc.mjs.description: Restrained warm grays. Minimal and quiet, so the content stays the focus.

themes/stone/stoneTheme.doc.mjs.name: stone
themes/stone/stoneTheme.doc.mjs.description: Warm stone and slate, earthy and understated, with just enough character to feel handcrafted.

themes/y2k/y2kTheme.doc.mjs.name: y2k
themes/y2k/y2kTheme.doc.mjs.description: Hot pinks, lime greens, and Poppins. Bubbly, playful, and unmistakably retro.
